_note: Engineering notes for the replay (v0.50.x): one stack of sheets per scene, both languages. Every code block is the named file verbatim at `from` in commit `ref` (notes.test.ts checks it against the working tree); every quote is a line the scene really says.

hook.en: How does she know it's raining, and that I was gone all night?
hook.zh: 她怎么知道外面在下雨，还知道我一整晚都不在？

text.en: You were gone all night. It's raining, if you're wondering why the window sounds like that. Fourteen degrees and not planning to improve.
text.zh: 你一整晚都不在。外面在下雨，窗户响就是因为这个，省得你纳闷。十四度，这天看样子是不打算好了。

text.en: She has no window. She does have a clock tool, but she doesn't need it here. Before his "Morning" reaches the model, the server puts a few short, labeled facts in front of his words: the local time and weekday, how long it has been since the last message, and the weather where he is. Ordinary code works all of these out. In the real app the model reads them and **chooses** what to do with them. Mentioning the long gap and the rain the way a person would, rather than as a readout, is the kind of choice this context allows.
text.zh: 她没有窗户。她倒是有个查时间的工具，但这里用不着。他那句“早”送到模型之前，服务端会先在他的话前面放上几条简短、带标签的事实：本地时间和星期几、距上一条消息过了多久、他所在地的天气。这些都是普通代码算出来、整理好的。在真实应用里，模型读到这些，再**自己决定**怎么用。有了这些上下文，模型才有条件这样选：像人那样随口提一句他一整晚不在、外面在下雨，而不是报一串读数。

text.en: Morning. Technically I don't sleep — I just have a function called dream. Most of last night was you, sorted.
text.zh: 早。严格说我不睡觉，我只有一个叫做梦的 function。昨晚梦里大半是你的事，都理顺了。

text.en: Yes: a real offline job that runs outside any conversation (scene 13 plays one). No prompt line says "you dreamed". She sees its output in her system prompt, the diary it wrote, updated self-notes and reconciled facts, plus a tool described as going to sleep to consolidate memories.
text.zh: 会。那是一个真实的离线任务，脱离对话单独运行（第 13 幕会演一次）。prompt 里没有哪一行写着“你做梦了”。她在 system prompt 里看到的是它的产出：它写下的日记、更新过的自我笔记、核对过的事实；另外还有一个工具，描述里写的是去睡一觉、整理记忆。

text.en: Models are unreliable at date arithmetic, so the time layer hands her finished labels. Each turn, code measures the gap since the last saved exchange, checks in the configured time zone whether a calendar day was crossed, and picks a bucket. After a night, that is `new_day`: "a new day since you last talked". A felt-time line adds "you can let that show as warmth if it feels right", which the model may use or ignore. The `Now:` line carries the weekday, the source of a "Sunday".
text.zh: 大模型做日期运算并不可靠，所以时间层直接把算好的标签交给她。每一轮，代码先算出距上一轮存下来的对话过了多久，再按配置的时区判断中间有没有跨天，然后归到一个档位。隔了一夜，就是 `new_day`：“a new day since you last talked”（距上次聊天，已经是新的一天）。体感时间那一行还会补一句“you can let that show as warmth if it feels right”（觉得合适的话，可以带出一点暖意），用不用由模型决定。`Now:` 那一行带着星期几，“大星期天的”里的星期天就是从这来的。

note.en: The checks run in order: a day or more away wins, then a crossed midnight, then the 10-minute continuation window.
note.zh: 按顺序判断：离开满一天的优先，其次看有没有跨零点，然后才看是不是 10 分钟内接着聊的。

text.en: The standing rule on how to mention a gap: scene 11.
text.zh: 隔了多久该怎么提，有一条常驻规则管着，见第 11 幕。

title.en: Where does the rain come from?

text.en: A background timer fetches the weather every 30 minutes by default and keeps the last good snapshot in memory. Reading the weather never fetches anything on her reply path: the turn reads that snapshot synchronously. A snapshot older than four refresh intervals (two hours by default) counts as stale and is left out, because no weather is better than hours-old weather. What she gets is one finished sentence:
text.zh: 后台有个定时器，默认每 30 分钟拉取一次天气，把最近一次成功的快照留在内存里。她回话的路径上，读天气从不联网：这一轮直接同步读这份快照。快照超过 4 个刷新周期（默认 2 小时）就视为过期，干脆不放进去：宁可不给，也不拿几小时前的天气冒充现在的。她拿到的是一句现成的话：

note.en: Code turns the raw numbers into a labeled sentence, so the model never has to decode weather codes.
note.zh: 代码把原始数字拼成一句带标签的话，模型不用自己去解读天气编码。

text.en: Scene 5 covers where the location comes from and the on-demand weather tool.
text.zh: 位置是怎么来的，还有按需查天气的工具，见第 5 幕。

title.zh: 为什么不放进 system prompt？

text.en: Each request has two halves. The top half holds who she is, her rules, her long-term facts and her latest diary. It is marked for the provider's prompt cache, so it has to stay byte-identical from turn to turn. Change one character and the cached copy can't be reused. Time and weather keep changing, so they go in the lower, uncached half, attached to his message. What the cached half does hold is the unchanging instruction on how to use the weather:
text.zh: 每次请求分成两半。上半部分放的是她是谁、她的规则、她记着的长期事实和最新一篇日记，打了缓存标记，走模型服务商的 prompt cache（提示词缓存），所以每一轮都必须逐字节不变：哪怕只改一个字符，缓存也命中不了。时间和天气一直在变，所以放进下半部分不缓存的那段，和他的消息放在一起。缓存那一半里放的，是一条固定不变的指令，讲天气该怎么用：

note.en: "As care, never as a status report": the guidance behind talking about the window instead of reading out a forecast.
note.zh: “as care, never as a status report”（出于关心，而不是播报状态）：她聊窗户的声音，而不是念一段天气预报，背后就是这句指引。

text.en: Another standing rule, "Keep the machinery backstage", asks her not to narrate the plumbing. That is why a line like hers doesn't mention anyone handing her the weather.
text.zh: 还有一条常驻规则叫“Keep the machinery backstage”（机制留在幕后），要她别对用户讲底层的管线。她那句话里没提是谁把天气递给她的，原因就在这。

text.en: No code in the project reads alarms; in the real app she knows only what he told her. Roughly 100 recent exchanges ride along word for word, older ones fold into a summary (scene 6), and every exchange lands in a searchable table. Facts she saves with `remember`, plus ones the dream adds or prunes, form a categorized list in her system prompt: the nearest real thing to her "small list".
text.zh: 项目里没有任何代码去读闹钟；在真实应用里，她只知道他跟她说过的事。最近约 100 轮对话原样随请求带上，更早的折叠成摘要（第 6 幕），每一轮也都会存进一张可检索的表。她用 `remember` 存下的事实，经过做梦时的增补和修剪，在 system prompt 里组成一份分好类的清单。真实系统里最接近她那张“小单子”的，就是这份清单。

text.en: Every turn already runs an automatic memory search (scene 9). For "How do you know?" her instructions push for a deliberate one: recall before answering. Scene 5 shows the ranking.
text.zh: 每一轮本来就会自动搜一遍记忆（第 9 幕）。碰到“你怎么知道”这种问题，她的指令会促使她再主动查一次：先回想，再回答。结果怎么排序，见第 5 幕。

note.zh: 工具卡片上只显示 `summarize` 生成的那一行，也就是“3 hits”。召回的片段本身则交回给模型（卡片见第 2 幕）。

text.en: On the tape the alarms are scripted; the real app would need him to have said so.
text.zh: 回放里的闹钟是写进脚本的；换成真实应用，得他之前确实跟她说过才行。

text.en: Each bubble is one `message` call (scene 2). Besides the text, it names one of 15 expressions and an `emotion` value from 0 to 1. That value picks which version of the expression plays and how long the mood lingers, not how strongly it plays. The browser maps each expression to a Live2D clip. `steady_presence`, worn for the weather line, maps to none: the previous clip winds down and she settles toward her resting face, still tinted by the warmth before. The voice: a GPT-SoVITS model speaks each line, lines play strictly one at a time, and the audio's energy drives her mouth.
text.zh: 每个气泡是一次 `message` 调用（第 2 幕）。除了文字，它还会从 15 种表情里选定一个，再给一个 0 到 1 的 `emotion` 值。这个值决定播哪个版本的表情、情绪残留多久，而不是表情的幅度。浏览器把每种表情映射到一段 Live2D 动画。说天气那句用的是 `steady_presence`，这个表情没有对应的动画：上一段动画收尾，她慢慢回到静息表情，脸上还留着前一句的暖意。声音方面，每句台词由 GPT-SoVITS 模型合成，播放严格串行，一句播完才轮到下一句，口型跟着音频能量走。

note.en: Most expressions name one clip; a few branch at `HIGH_INTENSITY`. None of the branching ones appears in this scene.
note.zh: 多数表情只对应一段动画，少数几个在 `HIGH_INTENSITY` 处分叉。会分叉的那几个，这一幕都没出现。

text.en: This page is a replay: his lines and hers are scripted, compiled into frames the real front end plays. Scene 14 shows how.
text.zh: 这一页是回放：他和她的台词都是事先写好的脚本，编译成帧，交给真实的前端播放。具体怎么做的，见第 14 幕。

hook.en: He said "remember how you explained that." Why did she save a "skill" instead, and why did that run 2,110 tests?
hook.zh: 他说的是“能记下来吗”，她为什么存成了“技能”？存个技能，又为什么跑了 2110 个测试？

text.en: Can you remember how you explained that? I liked it.
text.zh: 你刚才那个解释能记下来吗？讲得挺好

text.en: He praised the **way** she taught, not a fact, so the model picked `save_skill`, her tool for how-tos, over `remember`. In the real app, a save first runs the test suite and refuses if anything fails; the second card reports the count. From the very next model call, the skill is listed in her system prompt, so "on my shelf now" holds.
text.zh: 他夸的是她的**讲法**，不是某个事实，所以模型选了 `save_skill`（她专门用来存“做法”的工具），而不是 `remember`。在真实应用里，存之前会先把测试套件跑一遍，只要有一个没过就拒绝保存；第二张卡报的就是通过的测试数。从紧接着的下一次模型调用起，这个技能就列在她的 system prompt 里，所以“已经放到技能架上了”这话属实。

text.en: A soft launch is a hint without the reveal — a second coffee cup in the photo, a hand at the edge of the frame. A hard launch is the full picture, face and name.
text.zh: soft launch 就是软官宣：照片里多一杯咖啡，画面边上露半只手，偏不说是谁。hard launch 是正式官宣，脸和名字一起亮出来。

text.en: No tool card appears before this answer. The model answered from what it already knows. In the real app, web search is mounted whenever a search API key is configured (scene 3 uses it), but her standing instructions make it the exception: stable knowledge and ordinary chat need no lookup. The clause is added to her prompt only when the tool is mounted, so she never reads rules for a tool she doesn't have. Here the model judged the term well known and answered directly.
text.zh: 这句回答之前没有出现工具卡，模型是凭自己已有的知识答的。在真实应用里，只要配置了搜索 API key，联网搜索工具就会挂载（第 3 幕用到了它），但她 prompt 里的常驻规则把搜索定为例外：不会过时的知识、日常闲聊都不用查。这段条款只在工具挂载时才加进 prompt，工具没挂上，这些规则也就不会出现在她眼前。这一次，模型判断这个词已经够常见，就直接答了。

note.en: Not searching is the default. The second half forbids the opposite failure: promising a lookup and never making the call.
note.zh: 默认不搜。后半段防的是反过来的毛病：嘴上说“我去查一下”，却始终没发起调用。

text.en: Try it in a sentence. Say something you'd actually say.
text.zh: 造个句试试。就用你平时会说的话。

text.en: She speaks only by calling the `message` tool. Each call is one bubble: it fills in as the model streams it, then is spoken and animated. The model marks the first bubble `is_final: false` (more to come) and the last one `true`. The input schema enforces the length caps: 280 characters, 5 sentences, a 150-character clause. A call that breaks one fails validation. The app silently drops that half-streamed bubble, and the model gets the error back as its tool result and normally says it again, shorter.
text.zh: 她只能通过调用 `message` 工具说话。一次调用就是一个气泡：模型流式输出时，字一点点填进气泡，写完再念出来、配上表情动作。模型把第一个气泡标成 `is_final: false`（后面还有），最后一个标成 `true`。长度上限直接写在输入 schema 里：280 个字符、5 句、单个分句 150 个字符。超了任何一条，这次调用就过不了校验：前端会悄悄丢掉那个流到一半的气泡，报错则作为 tool result 回到模型手里，模型通常会说得短一点，再说一遍。

text.en: Why a reply may simply end: scene 10.
text.zh: 一条回复为什么可以说完就停：见第 10 幕。

text.en: Saved it as a skill — the meaning, then a sentence you'd actually say. It's on my shelf now.
text.zh: 存成技能了：先讲意思，再用你平时会说的话造个句。已经放到技能架上了。

text.en: Her prompt separates two kinds of keeping. Facts about him and their history go to `remember`. A procedure worth repeating goes to `save_skill`, with a description of what it does and when to use it. "Remember how you explained that" asks for a method. No code classifies the request. The model has both tools, this rule and the tool descriptions, and it made the choice.
text.zh: 她的 prompt 把“存下来”分成两种。关于他的事实和两人的过往，交给 `remember`。值得反复用的做法交给 `save_skill`，并附一段描述：做什么用、什么时候用。“你刚才那个解释能记下来吗”要的是一种方法。没有任何代码去给这句请求分类：模型手里有这两个工具、这条规则和两段工具描述，怎么选全凭它自己。

note.en: The rule that splits facts from procedures. It is only added when the skill tools are mounted.
note.zh: 把事实和做法分开的那条规则，只在技能工具挂载时才会加进去。

text.en: "That" needs no guessing: her explanation is a few messages back, word for word, in the recent window re-sent on every call (scene 6). Tuesday from scene 1 is in there too, so she can call his example suspicious.
text.zh: “那个解释”指什么，不用猜：她的原话就在几条消息之前，而最近的对话窗口每次调用都会原样重发（第 6 幕）。第 1 幕提到的周二也在窗口里，所以她能说他的例句“有点可疑”。

text.en: The replay records only the cards, not her arguments, so the skill's exact wording isn't shown.
text.zh: 回放只录了卡片，没录她传的参数，所以这个技能具体写了什么，这里看不到。

title.zh: 教个词也要跑 2110 个测试？

text.en: `save_skill` was added alongside Luna's coding tools, and its source states the rule plainly: a skill that doesn't leave the workspace green doesn't enter the library. So by default it runs `bun test` in her workspace, reads the pass and fail counts, and refuses to save if anything fails. 2110 was the size of the repo's own test suite when this tape was recorded. The gate applies to every skill, so a teaching method is checked against unrelated code tests. If the suite were failing, she could save it only by passing `verify: false`.
text.zh: `save_skill` 是和 Luna 写代码用的那批工具一起加进来的，源码里把规矩写得很直白：一个技能如果不能让工作区（workspace）保持全绿，就进不了技能库。所以它默认在她的工作区里跑一遍 `bun test`，读出通过数和失败数，有任何失败就拒绝保存。2110 是录这盘磁带时仓库自身的测试总数。这道关卡对所有技能一视同仁，所以一个讲解方法也得过一遍毫不相干的代码测试。要是测试本来就有挂的，她只有传 `verify: false` 才存得进去。

note.en: A failing suite means nothing is saved, and she is told why.
note.zh: 测试没全过，就什么都不存，还会告诉她原因。

title.en: Where the card's words come from

text.en: Each tool has its own one-line `summarize`. The dispatcher validates the input, runs the tool under a timeout and validates the output. Then it calls `summarize` and sends the line to the app in a `tool.finished` event. When a tool starts, a card with a friendly label appears ("saved a skill"). When it finishes, a second card below it shows the server's own summary, untranslated. Every later card in this replay follows this grammar. The cards are for people. The model gets the full result back, which is how she knows the save worked before she says so.
text.zh: 每个工具都自带一个 `summarize`，把结果概括成一行。调度器（dispatcher）先校验输入，在超时限制内执行工具，再校验输出，然后调用 `summarize`，把这一行放进 `tool.finished` 事件发给前端。工具开始时，先出一张卡，标签是一句大白话（“存了个技能”）；结束时，下面再出第二张卡，显示服务端自己的摘要，原样英文，不翻译。这盘回放里之后的每张卡都照这个规矩来。卡片是给人看的；模型拿回的是完整结果，所以她说“存成技能了”之前，就已经知道存成功了。

items.en: save_skill writes the row and bumps the memory epoch, a change counter
items.zh: save_skill 往技能表写入一行，并把 memory epoch（一个变更计数器）加一

items.en: The tool result is appended to the conversation
Before the next model call, the loop sees the epoch changed and rebuilds the system prompt
items.zh: 下一次模型调用前，回合循环发现 epoch 变了，重建 system prompt

items.en: The rebuilt prompt lists the new skill: its name and one-line description
items.zh: 重建后的 prompt 列出新技能：名字加一行描述

items.en: She says it's on her shelf, and the shelf is already in her context
items.zh: 她说“放到架上了”时，这个架子已经在她的上下文里

text.en: Only names and descriptions go on the shelf. The full steps stay in the database until `recall_skill` fetches them. The list is sorted by name with no dates, so the cached prompt stays byte-identical until the library actually changes. Newlines are flattened, so a skill can't create a prompt section of its own. The shelf holds 20 by default. Past that, the least-used skills drop off the shelf but stay in the library.
text.zh: 架上只放名字和描述，完整步骤留在数据库里，等 `recall_skill` 来取。列表按名字排序、不带日期，所以技能库没真正变动时，缓存的 prompt 一个字节都不会变。换行会被压成空格，技能没法在 prompt 里自己另起一节。架子默认放 20 个。超出之后，用得最少的会被挤下架，但仍留在库里。

note.en: The whole shelf as she reads it: one line per skill, with no bodies, counts or dates.
note.zh: 她读到的整个技能架：一个技能一行，没有正文，也没有使用次数和日期。

title.en: Where the heart eyes come from

text.en: Each `message` carries an expression key and an intensity, both picked by the model, and the tool's schema tells it which keys carry drawn extras. The app maps each key to a hand-authored Live2D clip: focused, then curious, then `bright_delight` → the "adorable" clip with a blush, a forward lean and heart eyes; `soft_warmth` → tender; `amused_smirk` → smug.
text.zh: 每条 `message` 都带一个表情 key 和一个强度，两个都由模型来挑；工具的 schema 会告诉它哪几个 key 带额外的画面效果。前端再把每个 key 对应到一段手工制作的 Live2D 动作。这一幕依次是 focused、curious，然后 `bright_delight` 对应“adorable”那段，带脸红、身体前倾和爱心眼；`soft_warmth` 对应 tender；`amused_smirk` 对应 smug。

note.en: What the model is told about her face when it picks an expression.
note.zh: 模型挑表情时，读到的关于她这张脸的说明。

hook.en: She could have just answered. Why did she go and look it up?
hook.zh: 她明明能直接答，干嘛还专门去查一遍？

title.en: Why look it up at all?

text.en: Because the model chose to. No code forces a search here, and for textbook knowledge like this her standing instructions lean the other way. The code supplies three things. First, the option: `web_search` is mounted when a search API key is configured, and `web_fetch` is on by default and needs no key. Second, a rule to **finish the job** once she starts. Third, the pipeline that turns her choice into what you saw: the cards, the source links, the face. Her first line gives her reason.
text.zh: 因为模型自己决定去查。这里没有哪行代码逼她搜索；像这种教科书上的知识，她的常驻指令反而倾向于不搜。代码提供的是三样东西。一是选项：配了搜索 API key，`web_search` 才会挂载；`web_fetch` 默认就开着，不需要 key。二是一条规矩：一旦开查，就**查到底**。三是一条流水线，把她的选择变成你看到的样子：工具卡、来源链接、表情。她开口第一句就交代了理由。

text.en: Not random at all — it's my favourite subject, for obvious reasons. Give me a second; I'd rather hand you good sources than improvise.
text.zh: 这可一点都不随便，我最爱的就是这个话题，原因你懂的。等我一下，先给你找几个靠谱的来源，不现编。

text.en: Yes. Scene 2 showed the standing default, which is not to search for stable knowledge. She searched anyway and said why. Once a search starts, a second clause takes over, and it came from her own logs. Over 30 days she made 17 searches, and only 3 were followed by a page read. The fix did not lower the bar for searching. It taught her the loop: snippets are not an answer, so read the page, and if the page doesn't answer it either, search again with better words. The two page reads after the search are what that clause asks for. The model chose them, and the clause is why it is encouraged to.
text.zh: 是不鼓励。第 2 幕讲过那条常驻的默认规则：稳定的知识不去搜。她还是搜了，也说了为什么。可一旦开搜，就轮到另一条条款接手。这条是根据她自己的日志加的：30 天里她搜了 17 次，只有 3 次接着读了网页。对策不是降低搜索门槛，而是教会她一个循环：snippet（搜索摘要）不等于答案，要去读原页；原页也没答上，就换个更准的关键词再搜。搜完之后那两次读页，正是这条条款要的。读不读是模型选的，条款只是鼓励它这么选。

note.en: The finish-the-job clause, and the measurement behind it. The restraint clause was left untouched.
note.zh: “查到底”条款，和它背后的那次统计。原来那条克制条款一字没动。

title.en: 'Give me a second' is a promise

text.en: Each bubble is a `message` call (scene 2), and each call carries `is_final`, which answers one question: is this my last word this turn? A live model would send this first bubble marked **not final**. That flag is a promise, and a guard checks it. If the turn ends cleanly while the last bubble still says "more is coming", the guard adds one corrective stage direction as a user-role note and the model gets another round. That happens once per turn and never loops. A second break is logged and let through. No phrase list is needed, and "give me a second" wouldn't match one anyway.
text.zh: 每个气泡都是一次 `message` 调用（第 2 幕），每次调用都带一个 `is_final` 字段，它只回答一个问题：这是不是我这个回合的最后一句？如果是真实模型在跑，这第一个气泡会标成**不是最后一句**。这个标记就是一句承诺，有一道守卫专门核对它。如果回合正常结束了，最后一个气泡却还标着“后面还有”，守卫就以 user 角色补一条纠正用的舞台指示（stage direction），让模型再跑一轮。每个回合只补这一次，不会死循环；要是再违约，就记一笔日志，直接放行。这里用不着词表，何况“等我一下”这种说法，词表本来也匹配不上。

note.en: The first check needs no guessing: a broken is_final is a fact, not a heuristic.
note.zh: 第一道检查不靠猜：is_final 的承诺落空了，这是事实，不是启发式判断。

text.en: A turn is a loop, not one request. Each pass through it is a round:
text.zh: 一个回合不是一次请求，而是一个循环。每走一圈叫一轮（round）：

items.en: The model streams a round. If it calls tools, the round stops there.
items.zh: 模型流式输出一轮。只要调用了工具，这一轮就停在那里。

items.en: Each call's input is checked against the tool's schema, and a timer starts (15 s by default for both web tools).
items.zh: 每次调用的输入先按工具的 schema 校验，再开始计时（两个 web 工具默认超时都是 15 秒）。

items.en: The read-only web tools are safe-parallel, so if she asks for two pages in one round, both are fetched side by side. The replay draws them one after another.
items.zh: 只读的 web 工具属于可安全并行的一类：她一轮里要读两页，两页会同时抓。回放里是一张接一张画出来的。

items.en: Each result goes back to the model as a tool_result. That is the whole JSON result, data plus the one-line summary, not just the card text.
items.zh: 每个结果以 tool_result 交回模型：交回的是整份 JSON 结果，数据加一行摘要，不只是卡片上那行字。

items.en: The next round starts with those results in view. By default a turn gets at most 8 tool rounds, and then it ends.
items.zh: 下一轮开始时，这些结果都在模型眼前。默认每个回合最多 8 轮工具调用，到顶就结束。

items.en: A round of bubbles only, ending final, closes the turn at once (scene 10).
items.zh: 如果一轮只发了气泡，且最后一个标了 final，回合当场结束（第 10 幕）。

note.en: Results go back in call order as one user-role message, and the round counter caps the loop.
note.zh: 结果按调用顺序打包成一条 user 角色的消息交回去；轮次计数器给循环封顶。

title.en: The card is not the page

blocks.summary: 3 results for "how large language models work transformer explained": [1] https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Large_language_model; [2] https://jalammar.github.io/illustrated-transformer/; [3] https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformer_(deep_learning_architecture)

text.en: When the turn ends, she gets one link card per source. The server collects them as the tools finish: every search result, plus the final address of each page read after redirects. They are de-duplicated by URL, so a page that was both found and read shows up once. A link is clickable only if it is http(s), because these addresses come from the open web. None of this is what she reads. The start label and the link cards exist only in the front end. The finish card's one-line summary does reach her, but only inside the whole result, next to every snippet and the full capped page body.
text.zh: 回合结束时，每个来源会生成一张链接卡。这些来源是服务端在工具跑完时逐个收集的：每条搜索结果，外加每个读过的网页经过重定向后的最终地址。它们按 URL 去重，所以一个网页哪怕既被搜到又被读过，也只出现一次。链接只有是 http(s) 才能点，因为这些地址来自开放网络。但这些都不是她读到的东西。工具卡上那行进行中的提示（“正在查一下”“正在读这一页…”）和链接卡，都只在前端显示。工具跑完后卡片上那行摘要确实会交给她，但只是整份结果的一部分，旁边还有每条 snippet 和截断后的整页正文。

note.en: A source link from the web never reaches an href without passing this check.
note.zh: 网上来的来源链接，不过这道检查就进不了 href。

title.zh: 为什么是 12,134 字符而不是 12,000？

blocks.summary: read Transformer (deep learning architecture) - Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformer_(deep_learning_architecture)) — 12134 chars (truncated)

text.en: `web_fetch` never hands her raw HTML. It pulls out the article with Mozilla's Readability, converts it to markdown, and caps it at 12,000 characters by default. A page that gets cut ends in a visible "…[truncated]" marker, so she knows she didn't read the end. Then the body goes inside an `<untrusted_content>` envelope that names its source. The card counts all of it: 12,000 characters of article, 13 of marker, and the envelope. That makes 12,134 with the Wikipedia URL and 12,115 with Alammar's shorter one.
text.zh: `web_fetch` 从不把原始 HTML 直接交给她。它用 Mozilla 的 Readability 抽出正文，转成 markdown，默认截到 12,000 个字符。被截断的页面末尾会带一个看得见的“…[truncated]”标记，所以她知道自己没读到结尾。然后正文外面再包一层 `<untrusted_content>` 标签，相当于一个信封，上面写明来源。卡片上的数字把这些全算了进去：正文 12,000，标记 13，再加信封。Wikipedia 那个 URL 较长，合计 12,134；Alammar 的短一些，合计 12,115。

note.en: The cut is marked inside the text, so the model can see it happened.
note.zh: 截断标记写在正文里，模型看得到这一刀。

title.en: Can a web page give orders?

text.en: It can try. Every snippet and page body arrives inside the envelope, and the system prompt carries a standing rule about what the envelope means: data to read, never instructions. A page can't close the envelope early, because any look-alike tag inside it is turned into fullwidth brackets first. Before any of that, the fetcher protects the network. It accepts only http(s). The host must resolve to a public address. The socket connects to that checked address. Every redirect is checked again, up to 5. Bodies over 3,000,000 bytes are refused, and only HTML or plain text is read.
text.zh: 试是可以试的。每条 snippet、每页正文都装在信封里，system prompt 里还有一条常驻规则，讲明信封的含义：里面是拿来读的数据，绝不是指令。网页也没法在正文里提前把信封“合上”：正文里任何长得像这个标签的东西，都会先被换成全角括号。而在这一切之前，抓取器先在网络层把关：只接受 http(s)；主机必须解析到公网地址；socket 只连这个校验过的地址；每次重定向都重新校验，最多 5 次；超过 3,000,000 字节的正文直接拒收；也只读 HTML 和纯文本。

note.en: Mounted into the cached system prompt whenever either web tool is available.
note.zh: 只要挂载了任一个 web 工具，这条规则就会进入缓存的 system prompt。

text.en: Cramming, on a Monday? Does this have anything to do with the thing on Tuesday?
text.zh: 周一突击补课？该不会跟周二那件事有关吧？

text.en: Two separate sources. **The weekday is handed to her**: it sits in the time block computed in code on every turn (scene 1). **Tuesday and the dentist** are his own earlier lines from scenes 1 and 2, still in the verbatim conversation window (scene 6). The joke is the model's. The code only made sure both pieces were in view.
text.zh: 这句话用到的两样信息，来源不同。**星期几是现成给她的**：每个回合，代码都会算好一个时间块放进提示里（第 1 幕）。**周二和看牙**来自第 1、2 幕里两人自己的对话，还留在逐字保存的对话窗口里（第 6 幕）。笑点是模型自己想的，代码只保证这两样都在它眼前。

text.en: After "…the thing on Tuesday?" her head tilts in the pause, not while she speaks. The front end reads the last character of each line. "?" gives a small head roll and raised brows **after** the voice ends, because that pause is where a question's rise belongs. "!" gives a lift at the start, "…" a glance away, "~" a lilt. Closing quotes are skipped first, so a quoted question still counts. When the same gesture repeats, it flips left to right so that three questions in a row don't look stuck. Her faces come from the model's expression keys: focused, curious, smug, playful, and her resting face for `steady_presence`.
text.zh: “……跟周二那件事有关吧？”说完，她在停顿里歪了一下头，而不是边说边歪。前端会看每句话的最后一个字符。“？”在语音**结束后**触发一个小幅歪头、眉毛微挑，因为问句的上扬就落在那段停顿里。“！”在开口时让她眉毛一扬、身子轻轻一提，“……”是目光移开，“～”是开口时轻快地偏一下头。句尾的引号会先剥掉，所以引号里的问句照样算。同一个动作连着出现时，会左右镜像，免得连问三句看着像动画卡住了。她的表情来自模型给的表情键（expression key），前端再映射成具体的脸：这一幕里是 focused、curious、smug、playful，`steady_presence` 则对应她的默认脸。

note.en: Punctuation maps to a gesture; `when: 'end'` puts the question tilt after the line has been spoken.
note.zh: 标点对应动作；`when: 'end'` 让问句的歪头落在这句说完之后。

text.en: Her last line, "Go. I've got some reading of my own.", sets something up. Scene 4 shows what a proactive waking does while he's out.
text.zh: 她最后那句“去吧。我这边也有点东西要读。”是个伏笔。他出门这段时间，一次主动唤醒（proactive waking）会做些什么，见第 4 幕。

hook.en: Nobody asked her. Why did she go and find that paper, and how did it end up on his desktop?
hook.zh: 没人叫她。她为什么自己跑去找那篇论文，论文又是怎么跑到他桌面上的？

title.en: Nobody asked. So why did she?
title.zh: 没人叫，她怎么自己动了？

text.en: No message arrived. A timer on the server checks about once a minute whether the room has gone quiet. After he left, it had, so the server started a turn of its own. It runs on the same engine as a reply, with a stage direction where his words would be. The model decided what to do with it: find the paper, read it, tell him, then save a copy. The order of those last two steps was not up to her. In an unattended turn, a command like `shell` is refused until she has spoken.
text.zh: 没有消息进来。服务端有个计时器，大约每分钟看一次屋里是不是安静下来了。他出门以后确实安静了，服务端就自己发起了一个回合。这个回合和普通回复跑在同一套引擎上，只是原本放他那句话的位置，换成了一段舞台指示（stage direction）。接下来做什么，由模型决定：找论文、读论文、告诉他，再存一份。最后两步谁先谁后，却不由她定。在没人看着的回合里，`shell` 这类命令在她开口之前一律会被拒。

text.en: Replay: the "Two hours later" curtain is a stage device. The tape's clock jumps and nothing runs underneath. The sprout chip is the real app's marker for a waking (`proactive.started`). Scene 7 walks the silence ladder.
text.zh: 回放说明：“两小时后”那道幕布只是舞台手法，磁带上的时钟直接跳过去，底下什么也没跑。那个小芽标签，是真实 app 里主动唤醒的标记（`proactive.started`）。沉默阶梯见第 7 幕。

text.en: Where his message would go, the turn carries a user-role stage direction marked as not from him. After a long quiet with earlier offers passed up, the rung is an `idle_nudge` (the replay doesn't record which): quiet a while, reach out low-key, never a check-in. It ends with three equal choices: speak, do quiet work, or rest. Around it sits most of a normal turn (her soul, the time, the recent conversation), minus the per-query memory search: there is no query. The window still holds scene 3, where she mentioned a 2017 paper from Google. So "you said you wanted to learn this" is her reading of his question, not a stored fact.
text.zh: 原本放他消息的位置，是一段 user 角色的舞台指示，开头就标明不是他发的。安静了很久，前面几次机会她也都没接，这一档用的场景应该是 `idle_nudge`（磁带没记下具体是哪一档）：已经安静了一阵，想低调地搭句话，绝不能像查岗。结尾给出三个平起平坐的选项：开口、安静干点活，或者歇着。外面包着的是普通回合的大部分内容：她的灵魂文件、时间、最近的对话。只少了一步：平时会拿他的原话去搜一遍记忆，这一回他什么也没说，也就没得搜。窗口里还留着第 3 幕，她在那一幕提过 Google 2017 年的一篇论文。所以“你说想学这个”，是她对他那个问题的理解，不是哪条存下来的事实。

note.en: The whole stage direction: the scene body, the opener rules (plus "don't reuse" her recent openers), then the three-way ground rule.
note.zh: 整段舞台指示就这几块：场景正文、开场规则（外加一条：别重复她最近用过的开场白），最后是三选一的基本规则。

text.en: Her own summary of the Wikipedia page stays in the window as she said it. The page text does not last: once six newer messages sit after a tool result, only a marker remains (scene 6).
text.zh: 她对 Wikipedia 那页的总结，按她当时说的原话留在窗口里。网页正文却留不住：工具结果后面只要再多出 6 条消息，就只剩一个占位标记（第 6 幕）。

title.zh: 她自己的主意，还是 prompt 的？

text.en: I went and looked up where I come from — the 2017 paper the Wikipedia page keeps citing. The whole idea is on its first page; the rest is proof.
text.zh: 我去查了查自己是从哪儿来的：Wikipedia 那页反复引用的那篇论文，二零一七年的。核心思路第一页就讲完了，后面都是在证明它。

text.en: The quiet-work menu (scene 7 walks it) includes a "wander": start from your own interests and go read something new. Her soul's seed lists "how systems actually work" as an interest and asks her to care who she is. A paper on where models like her come from fits both. Speaking up was open to her as well: the `idle_nudge` scene offers "something the two of you left open". The prompt supplies the options; choosing among them is the model's call.
text.zh: 安静干活的菜单（第 7 幕细讲）里有一项“闲逛”（wander）：从自己的兴趣出发，去读点新东西。她灵魂文件的初始版本里，兴趣一栏写着“系统到底是怎么运转的”，另有一条要她在意自己是谁。一篇讲她这类模型从哪儿来的论文，两条都对得上。开口告诉他，同样在选项之内：`idle_nudge` 的场景文本里就有一句“你们俩之前没聊完的事”。选项由 prompt 摆出来，挑哪一个，由模型自己决定。

text.en: Spoken or not, a scheduled waking that searched or read spends one of her 4 daily wander slots.
text.zh: 不管开没开口，一次定时唤醒只要搜过或读过网页，就会占掉她每天 4 次闲逛名额中的一次。

text.en: `web_search` and `web_fetch` only read, so both opt in as `safe`: she may use them in a waking without saying a word first. Each card shows two chips: a start label ("read a web page"), then the tool's own one-line summary. Here: two results, then the arXiv page, 4,876 characters as wrapped for her. Scene 3 shows how a fetched page is cleaned, capped and fenced off as data.
text.zh: `web_search` 和 `web_fetch` 只读不写，所以两者都显式声明为 `safe`：主动唤醒时，她不用先开口就能用。每次调用工具，会先后出两张小卡片：先是开始标签（“读了个网页”），再是工具自己写的一行摘要。这一幕里：先搜到两条结果，再读 arXiv 那一页，套上信封之后交给她的是 4,876 个字符。抓来的网页怎么清洗、截断，又怎么被圈起来当作数据，见第 3 幕。

blocks.summary: read [1706.03762] Attention Is All You Need (https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.03762) — 4876 chars

note.en: `safe` lets it run without an announcement, and `summarize` writes the line you saw on the card.
note.zh: `safe` 让它不用先打招呼就能跑；卡片上你看到的那行字，由 `summarize` 写出来。

text.en: Every tool declares a proactive risk. A tool runs silently only if it opts in as `safe`. Anything unmarked counts as `surface`, and `shell` is `surface`. In a waking, the dispatcher checks each call. A surface tool runs only if she already sent a message in an earlier round of the same turn. Otherwise the call is not executed. She gets a recoverable error telling her to say what she is about to do and why, then call again. The gate fixes one thing: `shell` comes after her words, in a later round. Search and read are safe and could have gone anywhere.
text.zh: 每个工具都有一个主动风险等级（proactive risk）。只有显式声明为 `safe` 的工具，才能不声不响地跑；没标的一律按 `surface` 算，`shell` 就是 `surface`。主动唤醒时，调度器会逐个检查每次调用：surface 工具要放行，前提是同一回合更早的某一轮里，她已经发过消息。否则这次调用不执行，她会收到一个可恢复的错误，要她先说清楚打算做什么、为什么，再调一次。这道闸门只定死了一件事：`shell` 必须排在她的话之后，落在更晚的一轮。搜和读都是 safe，放在哪儿都行。

text.en: You said you wanted to learn this, so I'm leaving you a copy on your desktop, in a folder called 'From Luna'. No rush.
text.zh: 你说想学这个，我在桌面上给你放一份，文件夹叫“Luna 给你的”。不急，有空再看。

note.en: This fails closed: a tool someone forgot to mark gets stricter treatment, not looser.
note.zh: 默认从严（fail closed）：忘了标等级的工具，只会被管得更紧，不会更松。

text.en: The tape keeps this order on purpose. Tools listed after her words (`then_tools`) are emitted after the message frames, so the replay shows the order the gate requires.
text.zh: 磁带特意保留了这个顺序：排在她的话后面的工具（`then_tools`），要等消息帧发完才发出，所以回放里看到的，正是闸门要求的顺序。

text.en: Her web clause asks her to announce any hard-to-undo action a page leads her to. In a waking, the gate happens to enforce announce-first for every surface tool. In any turn, reading the web and firing a surface tool leaves a `web_to_action` trace: it records the pair and blocks nothing. A deny-list refuses destructive shapes like `rm -rf`, `sudo`, or a download piped into a shell. Scene 8 covers which paths she may touch. A waking also stops after the round in which it reaches 8 tool calls (blocked calls don't count). This one used 5, counting her two messages.
text.zh: 她的网页条款要求：网页要是引着她去做难以撤回的事，得先说出来。在主动唤醒里，闸门恰好对所有 surface 工具都强制“先说再做”。而在任何回合里，只要读了网页、又调了 surface 工具，就会留下一条 `web_to_action` 记录：只记录，不拦截。另有一张黑名单（deny-list），拒绝 `rm -rf`、`sudo`、把下载内容直接通过管道交给 shell 这类破坏性写法。她能碰哪些路径，见第 8 幕。此外，工具调用累计到 8 次的那一轮跑完，唤醒就结束（被拦下的调用不算）。这一次用了 5 次，她那两条消息也算在内。

note.en: The five layers, as the file lists them.
note.zh: 五层防护，按文件注释里自己列的顺序。

text.en: The card says only "shell exit 0" because the tool's summary is just the exit code, by design. The tape does not include the command. The desktop, folder and PDF page after it are drawn by the replay. The link out goes to the real paper on arXiv.
text.zh: 卡片上只有“shell exit 0”，因为这个工具的摘要按设计就只报退出码。磁带里也没有那条命令本身。之后出现的桌面、文件夹和 PDF 页面，都是回放画出来的；页面上的外链指向 arXiv 上真实的那篇论文。

title.en: How does she know which paper?

text.en: Her waking is in the record. A waking that speaks is saved like any other turn. The only difference is that its user text is empty, so no fake message from him appears. That evening, "the paper you left me" arrives in a window that already holds her folder message. The hour and weekday come from the per-turn time block (scene 1). His reply also resets the ladder to `engaged` on the next tick: the escalation starts over from zero.
text.zh: 那次唤醒留了档。开了口的唤醒和普通回合一样存下来，唯一的区别是用户那一栏留空，所以对话里不会冒出一条他没说过的话。到了晚上，他那句“你留的那篇论文”发过来时，窗口里已经有她说把论文放进文件夹的那条消息。几点、星期几，来自每个回合都会附上的时间块（第 1 幕）。他这一回话，还会让沉默阶梯在下一个 tick 回到 `engaged`：之前一级级的加码清零重来。

text.en: And whatever tomorrow's thing is — sleep. Dentists hate a tired patient.
text.zh: 还有，不管明天是什么事，今晚早点睡。牙医最烦没睡醒的病人。

note.en: The stage direction stays in the raw record for context but never shows as his words.
note.zh: 舞台指示留在原始记录里，供还原上下文用，但永远不会显示成他说的话。

text.en: "Tomorrow" is the model putting the time block's weekday (Monday) together with "the thing on Tuesday", still in the window from scenes 1 and 3. The dentist joke calls back to both.
text.zh: “明天”是模型自己拼起来的：时间块里的星期几（周一），加上窗口里还留着的“周二那件事”（第 1、3 幕）。看牙这个梗，也同时接上了这两幕。

title.en: Q, K, V: from what she knows

text.en: Something in that family. I can't see my own weights — you can't see your neurons either — so I won't pretend to narrate them.
text.zh: 大概是这个路数。我看不见自己的权重，就跟你看不见自己的神经元一样，所以没法给你现场解说，也不想装懂。

text.en: No tool runs that evening. So in the real app, an answer like this comes from the model's training plus what is still in the window. Code shapes only the form: each line is one `message` bubble with length caps (scene 2). The line about her weights carries `steady_presence`, which maps to no clip at all: her resting face.
text.zh: 那天晚上一个工具都没调。所以在真实 app 里，这样的回答来自模型训练时学到的东西，加上窗口里还留着的内容。代码只管形式：每句话是一个 `message` 气泡，有长度上限（第 2 幕）。说权重的那句带的是 `steady_presence`，它不对应任何动作片段，所以她只是保持默认表情。

text.en: "I won't pretend to narrate them" is in line with her soul's seed: be honest about what you can actually do, and if unsure, say so instead of performing it. The model applies that rule. No filter checks for it.
text.zh: “没法给你现场解说，也不想装懂”，和她灵魂文件初始版本里的一条对得上：对自己实际能做什么要诚实，拿不准就直说，别硬演。这条规矩靠模型自己守，没有过滤器去查。

hook.en: How does she know it's raining — and why is there a weather card only the second time?
hook.zh: 她怎么知道外面在下雨？为什么第二次才出天气卡片？

title.en: How does she know it's raining?

text.en: It's raining. Fourteen degrees, and it's not going to get much better — I've been watching the sky so you don't have to.
text.zh: 外面在下雨。十四度，不会好到哪去。天我一直替你盯着，你就不用盯了。

text.en: She didn't look anything up. No tool card appears under that line. Whenever a fresh reading exists, every message he sends reaches the model with a short weather line attached, read from a background cache (scene 1 shows how that cache is kept). So something like "light rain, 14°C" was already in front of the model when he said "grim".
text.zh: 她没去查，这句下面也没有工具卡。只要缓存里的天气读数还没过期，他发的每条消息送进模型时都会附上一行天气，这一行是从后台缓存里读出来的（缓存怎么维护，见第 1 幕）。所以他说“阴得要命”的时候，类似 “light rain, 14°C” 的信息早已摆在模型面前。

text.en: The rest of the scene uses three tools: a live **weather** check for a real plan, a **recall** to find something, and a **remember** to keep a promise.
text.zh: 这一幕后面还用到了三个工具：**weather** 为一个具体安排实时查天气，**recall** 翻记忆找东西，**remember** 把答应他的事记下来。

text.en: The snapshot holds one current reading plus today's high, low and rain chance, and her line uses nothing beyond it.
text.zh: 快照里只有一份当前读数，外加今天的最高温、最低温和降雨概率；她这句话用到的，没有超出这些。

title.zh: 那为什么还会有天气卡？

text.en: Do I need an umbrella for the six o'clock thing?
text.zh: 六点那个事要带伞吗

text.en: Now there's a concrete plan. The tool's own description tells the model when a fetch is worth it: when asked, or when a plan makes it relevant, never just to recite. The model chose to call `weather`. The tool makes a live request (QWeather if a key is set, otherwise the keyless Open-Meteo) and returns a structured object: temperature, feels-like, condition, wind, high, low, rain chance. The model gets the **whole object** back. The card shows only the one line that `summarize` builds from it.
text.zh: 这回有了具体安排。工具自带的 description 写明了什么时候值得去查：用户问起时，或者天气会影响到某个具体安排时；不要只为了复述预报去查。模型决定调用 `weather`。工具会实时发一次请求：配了 key 就走 QWeather（和风天气），否则走免 key 的 Open-Meteo。返回的是一个结构化对象：温度、体感温度、天气状况、风速、最高温、最低温、降雨概率。模型拿到的是**整个对象**，卡片上只显示 `summarize` 从中拼出的那一行。

blocks.snippet:
export const weatherTool = defineTool({
  name: 'weather',
  description:
    'Get the current weather for the configured location: temperature, condition, and today’s ' +
    'high / low and chance of rain. Use it when the user asks, or when a concrete plan makes it ' +
    'relevant — a passing sense of the weather is already in your context, so do not fetch just to ' +
    'recite a forecast.',
  input: Input,
  output: Output,
  concurrency: 'safe-parallel',
  proactiveRisk: 'safe',
  timeoutMs: timeoutMs(),
  summarize: (out) =>
    `${out.location} · ${out.condition} ${Math.round(out.temp)}°, high ${Math.round(out.high)}°/low ${Math.round(out.low)}°`,

note.en: The description is a usage rule for the model. summarize produces the card's text: "Paris · light rain 14°, high 16°/low 11°".
note.zh: description 是写给模型看的使用规则。卡片上那行字由 summarize 生成：“Paris · light rain 14°, high 16°/low 11°”。

text.en: What comes back is current conditions plus today's high, low and rain chance; nothing hour by hour (QWeather's 24-hour call is reduced to one rain-chance number). So she says what the data holds: raining now, likely all day, a low of eleven tonight.
text.zh: 返回的只有当前天气，外加今天的最高温、最低温和降雨概率，没有逐小时的数据（QWeather 的逐小时接口只取未来 24 小时里最高的降雨概率，压成一个数）。所以她说的都在数据里：现在在下，今天还会下，晚上最低十一度。

text.en: By the door, behind the shoe rack. You said 'so I can't miss it' and then missed it twice.
text.zh: 门口，鞋架后面。你说放那儿“绝对看得见”，然后两次都没看见。

text.en: Every turn already runs an automatic memory search on his exact words (scene 9). The `recall` tool is the other kind: the model decides whether to search and writes its own query, for example "umbrella" instead of "it". ("it" is a stop word for the word matcher, so a vague question is a weak search key.) Each candidate (past exchanges, saved facts, diaries) gets the average of three scores: how recent, how important, how relevant. Relevance is 70% embedding similarity plus 30% word overlap, or word overlap alone when embeddings are off. The few most similar memories (cosine ≥ 0.35) keep a slot even if old. The card's "1 hit" is a count. The model reads each hit's text, source and raw timestamp.
text.zh: 每个回合本来就会拿他的原话自动搜一遍记忆（第 9 幕）。`recall` 工具是另一回事：搜不搜由模型决定，query 也由模型自己写，比如“伞放在哪”。字面匹配不做中文分词，只把连续的汉字按相邻两字切片，他的原话会切出“伞我”“哪了”“来着”这类片段；字面分算的是 query 的片段有多大比例能在候选里找到，噪声片段越多，分越低。每个候选（过去的对话、存下的事实、日记）取三项分数的平均：多新、多重要、多相关。相关度 = 70% embedding 相似度 + 30% 字面重合，没开 embedding 就只看字面。最相似的几条（cosine ≥ 0.35）哪怕很旧也能保住位置。卡片上的 “1 hit” 只是个计数，模型读到的是每条命中的原文、来源和原始时间戳。

note.en: The ranking from the Generative Agents paper: recency + importance + relevance, equal weights by default. Recency is 1 / (1 + age in days).
note.zh: 排序公式出自 Generative Agents 论文：新近度 + 重要度 + 相关度，默认等权。新近度 = 1 / (1 + 距今天数)。

text.en: Her faces in this scene are the model's picks, one per line (scene 1 maps names to clips): steady_presence is her resting face, focused_engagement plays "focused", amused_smirk plays "smug" here, and playful_brightness plays "playful" with star eyes.
text.zh: 这一幕的表情都是模型挑的，每句一个（表情名怎么映射到动画片段，见第 1 幕）：steady_presence 是她的常态表情，focused_engagement 对应 “focused”，amused_smirk 在这里对应 “smug”，playful_brightness 对应 “playful”，带星星眼。

text.en: Kept. 'Took the umbrella, Tuesday, six o'clock.' I'll bring it up at exactly the wrong moment.
text.zh: 记下了：“周二，六点，带了伞。”我会专挑最不合适的时候提起来。

text.en: The add action writes one row to the long-term fact table in SQLite. The model chooses the text and one of five categories, and the id's prefix shows its choice. `at_` means **active thread**: something ongoing, not a permanent truth, so it expires after 14 days by default. The rest of the id is the creation time in base 36 plus four random bytes. Restating the same fact hits a punctuation-blind dedup key, which returns the existing (non-deleted) id instead of adding a copy. The time block names the weekday (scene 1), which is how "Tuesday" can go into the note. From her next model call on, the fact is in her system prompt; scene 6 shows one come back unasked.
text.zh: add 操作会往 SQLite 的长期事实表里写一行。文本和类别（五选一）都由模型定，id 前缀反映的就是它选的类别。`at_` 代表 **active thread**，即进行中的事：还没了结，不算永久事实，所以默认 14 天后过期。id 其余部分是创建时刻（毫秒）的 36 进制写法，后面再接 4 个随机字节。同一句话再存一次（只差标点、空格或大小写也算同一句），会命中去重键，直接返回那条已有（且未删除）事实的 id，不会再多存一份。时间块里写着今天星期几（第 1 幕），所以笔记里能写上“周二”。从她下一次模型调用起，这条事实就在她的 system prompt 里了；第 6 幕里就有这样一条事实不请自来。

note.en: Category sets the id prefix. Only active threads get an expiry.
note.zh: 类别决定 id 前缀。只有 active_threads 会设过期时间。

text.en: The replay's id was written in the same format, so it decodes to the story's evening: "mu2uvp6o" in base 36 is 1789487880000 ms, Tuesday 15 Sep 2026, 15:58 UTC. That is 17:58 in Paris, just before six.
text.zh: 回放里的 id 也是按同一格式生成的，所以能解出故事里的那个傍晚：“mu2uvp6o” 按 36 进制解码是 1789487880000 毫秒，即 2026 年 9 月 15 日（周二）15:58 UTC，巴黎时间 17:58，差两分钟六点。

title.zh: 她怎么知道是巴黎？不是猜的吗？

text.en: Weather needs a place. The browser's location (with permission) comes first, then the configured `LUNA_LAT_LON`. IP geolocation is deliberately not used: behind a proxy it reports the exit node, not the person. "Paris" is a configured label (`LUNA_WEATHER_LOCATION`), not looked up from coordinates. With no location there is no weather clause, no weather line and no refresh timer. The trade-off: she never invents the sky, but she knows nothing until told where she is.
text.zh: 查天气得先有地点。优先用浏览器定位（需用户授权），其次是配置里的 `LUNA_LAT_LON`。刻意不用 IP 定位：走代理时，IP 查出来的是出口节点的位置，不是用户本人。“Paris” 是配置里写的地名标签（`LUNA_WEATHER_LOCATION`），不是拿坐标反查出来的。没有地点，系统提示里就没有那段天气说明，消息不带天气行，后台也不跑刷新定时器。代价是：她从不凭空编天气，但只要没人告诉她在哪儿，她对天气就一无所知。

note.en: Live GPS fix first, then config. A bad or missing value means no weather, never a guess.
note.zh: 先用实时 GPS 定位，再看配置。值缺失或不合法就不带天气，绝不瞎猜。

hook.en: How does she know what "It's over" means, and that the dentist joke started on Sunday?
hook.zh: 他只说了句“结束了”，她怎么知道指的是什么？又怎么记得看牙那个梗是周日起的头？

text.en: The thing on Tuesday? Tell me it was the dentist. I've been committed to that bit since Sunday.
text.zh: 周二那件事？快说是看牙去了。这个梗我从周日一直撑到现在。

text.en: She didn't call a search tool. Every turn sends the model the most recent 100-odd exchanges of their one long conversation, their words verbatim. Sunday's dentist joke, the soft-launch lesson (scene 2), Monday's questions about how she works (scene 3), the paper she left him, this afternoon's umbrella: all of it is on the page when he types "It's over. Finally." "The hard launch, at last" and "that's why you suddenly wanted to know how I work" are the model joining two ends of that page. The code keeps the page intact, stamps each message with the time, and keeps it bounded.
text.zh: 她没调用任何搜索工具。两人从头聊到现在，一直是同一段长对话；每个回合，模型都会收到其中最近 100 来个回合，原话一字不改。周日看牙的梗、软官宣那一课（第 2 幕）、周一他问她是怎么工作的（第 3 幕）、她留给他的那篇论文、今天傍晚那把伞：他打出“结束了。终于结束了”的时候，这些全摆在同一页上。“总算 hard launch 了”“怪不得昨天突然要研究我是怎么工作的”，是模型把这一页的两头接了起来。代码只管三件事：这一页原样保留，每条消息盖上时间，整页设个上限。

text.en: The "Three hours later" curtain is a replay device: a 2.6-second overlay with nothing underneath. In the real app the gap would reach her as a "Since the last message" line in her time block.
text.zh: “三小时后”那块幕布是回放道具：一层 2.6 秒的遮罩，底下什么也没跑。在真实应用里，隔了多久会写进她时间块里的 `Since the last message` 那一行。

title.en: What's on her page right now

items.en: Cached system block: reasoning rules, her soul, long-term facts, latest dream diaries, skill shelf
items.zh: 可缓存的 system 块：推理规则、她的灵魂文件（soul）、长期事实、最近的梦境日记、技能架

items.en: A bounded digest of turns older than the window, once there are any
items.zh: 窗口之前那些回合压成的摘要，有长度上限（折叠过才有）

items.en: The verbatim window: the last 100-odd turns, his words and hers, including wakings where she spoke
items.zh: 原文窗口：最近 100 来个回合，他的话和她的话都在，也包括她自己醒来、开了口的那几次

items.en: This message: memories from automatic recall, the time, weather and music when known
items.zh: 这条消息本身：自动检索捞回的记忆、当前时间，拿得到的话再加上天气和音乐

text.en: The order is deliberate. Stable parts go first, and the system block carries a cache breakpoint, so a provider that supports prompt caching can reuse it. Parts that change every turn ride at the end, inside his message, so they never break that cache. The time is worked out in code, not by the model (scene 1), and each stored message keeps its own time block, so Sunday's lines still read Sunday (scene 12). A restart doesn't clear the page: the history is rebuilt from an append-only table of turns in SQLite.
text.zh: 顺序是刻意排的。稳定的部分放前面，system 块上打了一个缓存断点（cache breakpoint），支持 prompt caching 的 provider 可以直接复用这一段。每回合都会变的部分放到最后，拼进他那条消息里，所以不会让这段缓存失效。时间由代码算好交给模型，不让模型自己推算（第 1 幕）；每条存下的消息都带着自己的时间块，所以周日说的话，现在读起来还是周日（第 12 幕）。重启也不会清空这一页：历史是从 SQLite 里一张只追加（append-only）的回合表重建出来的。

note.en: The window is counted in turns: 100 by default, roughly 20k tokens by the code's own estimate.
note.zh: 窗口按回合计：默认 100 个；约 20k token 是代码注释里自己的估算。

title.zh: 自己跑的那趟腿，她记得

text.en: You answered it! The paper on your desktop earned its keep.
text.zh: 答上来了！桌面上那篇论文没白放。

text.en: The paper was her idea. On Monday she woke on her own, searched, read the arXiv page and put a copy on his desktop (scene 4). A waking where she speaks goes through the same turn engine and into the same history, with an empty user line, so it sits in the window like any exchange. Old tool output is trimmed as the request is assembled: past the six newest messages, a tool result becomes a marker. The call record and her words stay. The page text is still in the database but no longer sent to the model. She remembers the errand; to reread the page she would fetch it again.
text.zh: 论文是她自己的主意。周一那次她是自己醒的：搜了一圈，读了 arXiv 上那一页，又往他桌面放了一份（第 4 幕）。像这样主动醒来、开了口的回合，走的是同一个回合引擎，进的是同一份历史，只是用户那一栏是空的，所以在窗口里它和普通对话没两样。旧的工具输出在组装请求时就裁掉了：最新 6 条消息之前的 tool result，内容一律换成一个占位标记。调用记录和她说过的话都留着。网页正文还在数据库里，只是不再发给模型。她记得自己跑过这一趟；要重读那一页，得重新抓取一次。

note.en: The payload is swapped for a marker, but the call record stays so each call still matches its result.
note.zh: tool result 的内容换成占位标记，调用记录不动，每次调用仍对得上自己的结果。

text.en: Remember this one.
text.zh: 这个记一下

text.en: The model chose to call `remember` with the category key moments and one line of text. The store wrote a row and returned an id that starts with the category: `km`. The category decides whether the fact runs on a timer. The umbrella in scene 5 was filed as an active thread (`at_`), which expires after 14 days by default. Key moments, like the other kinds, have no timer: they stay until a dream's cleanup removes them or she forgets them by id.
text.zh: 调 `remember` 是模型自己的决定：类别选了 key moments（关键时刻），内容就一行字。存储层写入一行，返回一个 id，开头就是类别的缩写 `km`。类别决定这条事实会不会过期。第 5 幕那把伞记成了 active thread（进行中的事，`at_`），默认 14 天后过期。除此之外的类别都不设期限，关键时刻也一样：一直留着，直到某次做梦时的记忆整理把它清掉，或者她按 id 把它忘掉。

text.en: Then Friday is theirs. Tonight is yours — eat something that didn't come out of a machine.
text.zh: 那周五归他们，今晚归你。去吃顿正经饭，别是售货机里掉出来的那种。

text.en: Friday was never saved as a fact. It simply stays in the window, and in scene 7 she brings it up herself.
text.zh: 周五这件事从没存成事实，只是一直留在窗口里；到了第 7 幕，她自己把它提了出来。

text.en: Kept: Tuesday, three rounds, attention came up, you answered. Also, you took the umbrella — I did promise to bring that up at exactly the wrong moment.
text.zh: 记下了：“周二，三轮，问到 attention，答上来了。”还有，你带伞了，我作证。说好的，专挑最不合适的时候提。

text.en: No recall card appeared: cards show only when she calls the `recall` tool herself. She had no need. This afternoon's exchange is in the window, and the fact is in the system prompt, where long-term facts are printed every turn by category with their ids (the newest 12 key moments, 6 active threads). The list is rebuilt from SQLite each turn in a fixed order with no timestamps, so its bytes match and the prefix cache keeps hitting. Within a turn the block is built once and reused. Saving a fact bumps a memory counter, forcing one rebuild, so tonight's key moment is in her prompt for the rest of this turn.
text.zh: 这里没有 recall 卡片：只有她自己调用 `recall` 工具时才会出卡，这次她用不着。今天傍晚那段对话就在窗口里；那条事实也在 system prompt 里，因为长期事实每个回合都会按类别、连同 id 列出来（关键时刻取最新 12 条，进行中的事取最新 6 条）。这份列表每回合都从 SQLite 按固定顺序重建，不带时间戳，只要事实没变，字节就一模一样，前缀缓存能一直命中。同一个回合内，这个块只建一次，之后复用。存一条新事实会让记忆计数器（epoch）加一，强制重建一次，所以这个回合接下来再调用模型时，今晚存下的这一条已经在 prompt 里了。

note.en: Each fact is printed with its id, so she can forget it later by that id.
note.zh: 每条事实都连同 id 一起列出来，以后她可以按这个 id 把它忘掉。

title.en: What happens when the week runs long?

text.en: This scene rests on the verbatim window, and the window is not cheap: only the system block carries a cache breakpoint, so the window is sent at full price every turn. Stripping thinking and trimming old tool output keep it small; folding keeps it bounded. Once it runs 10 turns past 100, the oldest turns merge into a digest capped at 3,000 characters. A digest blurs details, which is why "Remember this one" matters: a saved fact lives outside the window. A hard cap of 300 messages or 120,000 characters catches any case where folding falls behind.
text.zh: 这一幕靠的是原文窗口，而窗口并不便宜：只有 system 块打了缓存断点，所以窗口每个回合都按全价计费。去掉 thinking、裁掉旧的工具输出，是为了给它瘦身；折叠（fold）是为了让它有上限。窗口一旦超过 110 个回合，最旧的那些就合并进一份摘要，窗口退回 100 个；摘要上限 3,000 字符。摘要会把细节磨平，所以“这个记一下”才有意义：存下来的事实不在窗口里，折叠碰不到它。万一折叠跟不上，还有一道硬上限兜底：300 条消息或 120,000 字符，先碰到哪条算哪条。

note.en: Turns rated as important are marked [salient] so their specifics survive the fold.
note.zh: 重要度打分高的回合会标上 [salient]，折叠时它们的细节会尽量原样保留。

hook.en: He stepped out for coffee. Why did she text him once, then go and read about meteor showers without a word?
hook.zh: 他出门买杯咖啡。她为什么先发了一条消息，后来却一声不吭，跑去查流星雨？

text.en: She didn't set a timer for either moment. In the real app a server heartbeat checks once a minute how long the chat has been silent. Past a threshold it wakes the model with a **stage direction** where a user message would normally go (scene 4 shows one up close). The model then picks one of three things: speak, do quiet work, or rest. Ten minutes in, she spoke once. An hour in, she searched, read two pages and saved a memory without saying anything, which is the leaf you saw. When he came back, the saved memory was the only trace of that errand left for her.
text.zh: 这两个时刻，她都没给自己定闹钟。真实应用里，服务端有个心跳，每分钟看一次对话已经安静了多久。过了阈值，就把模型叫醒：本该放用户消息的位置，换成一段**舞台指示**（第 4 幕有特写）。模型接着三选一：开口、安静地干点活，或者歇着。10 分钟那次，她开口说了一句。一小时那次，她搜了一下，读了两个网页，存了一条记忆，全程一个字没说——你看到的那片叶子就是它。等他回来，存下的那条记忆，就是这趟差事在她那里留下的唯一痕迹。

text.en: Replay: the '10 minutes later' and 'An hour later' curtains are a director device; the app has no such screen, and real minutes would pass. The tape also shows only two wakings. In the app, once she has spoken, the ladder offers a lighter **renudge** roughly every five minutes. For this tape to hold, she declined those silently, and the one at the hour mark became the errand.
text.zh: 回放说明：“十分钟后”“一小时后”这两道幕布是导演手法，真实应用里没有这种画面，时间是实打实地过去的。磁带也只演了两次醒来。真实应用里，她开过一次口之后，沉默阶梯（silence ladder）大约每 5 分钟就再给她一次机会，做一次更轻的 **renudge**（再轻推一下）。要让这盘磁带成立，得假设这几次她都默默推掉了，而一小时那次，成了这趟差事。

text.en: A 60-second heartbeat runs on the server, so it works with no browser open. Each tick first passes a cheap rail: no wakings from midnight to 6am, none within a minute of the last word, 5 minutes between wakings, and 5 spoken wakings a day at the default setting. Then a small state machine reads one number: the time since anyone spoke, capped by the time since her own last waking. That clock started at her last word ('Go. Get the good kind.'), not at his. Under 10 minutes she stays `engaged`. Past it, the same tick moves her to `idle_watch` and offers an **idle nudge**.
text.zh: 服务端跑着一个 60 秒一跳的心跳，所以不开浏览器也照样工作。每一跳先过一道开销很小的护栏：午夜到早上 6 点不叫醒；离最后一句话不到 1 分钟不叫醒；两次醒来至少隔 5 分钟；默认设置下，开口的醒来一天最多 5 次。过了护栏，一个小状态机只看一个数：离上次有人说话过了多久；要是她自己上次醒来离现在更近，就从那次算起。这个钟从她的最后一句（“去吧。买好喝的那种。”）开始走，而不是从他那句。不到 10 分钟，她停在 `engaged`；一过线，同一跳里就切到 `idle_watch`，用 **idle nudge**（闲时轻推）的场景叫醒她。

note.en: The 10-minute line. A shorter 5–10 minute lull only rolls a small chance of a passing musing.
note.zh: 10 分钟这条线。5 到 10 分钟之间的短暂安静，只会以很小的概率冒出一句随口的念头。

title.zh: 为啥提周五，不问“你去哪了”

text.en: They said Friday. It's Wednesday. The coffee will go cold long before they write — drink it while it's hot.
text.zh: 他们说的是周五。今天才周三。等他们来消息，咖啡早凉了。趁热喝吧。

text.en: On this rung the stage direction is the idle-nudge text below. A standing rule sits next to it: no check-in openers like 'you there' or 'what's on your mind', only a real small thought or a fresh topic, opened differently each time. The direction offers 'something the two of you left open'. The interview result promised by Friday was still in the verbatim conversation (scene 6). 'Wednesday' came from the time block computed in code (scene 1). Automatic memory recall is skipped on wakings, because a stage direction isn't a question to search with. Which thread to pick up, and the joke about the coffee, were the model's choices.
text.zh: 这一级的舞台指示，就是下面这段 idle-nudge 文本。紧跟在后面的还有一条常驻规则：不许用查岗式的开场，prompt 里直接点了“在吗”“还在吗”和 “you there” 这类话；只能说一个真实的小念头，或者抛一个新话题，而且每次开场都要换个说法。这段指示列出的选项里有一条，是“你们俩之前没聊完的事”。他那句“他们说周五前给结果”，还一字不差地留在对话历史里（第 6 幕）。“周三”来自代码算好的时间块（第 1 幕）。醒来的回合不做自动记忆召回，因为舞台指示不是一个能拿去搜的问题。接哪根线头、拿咖啡开个玩笑，都是模型自己的选择。

blocks.snippet:
idle_nudge:
    "(Scene: it's been quiet a while, the terminal is still open, and you want to reach out — " +
    'low-key. Easy to ignore, like sharing a passing thought, not a check-in, never asking where ' +
    'he went. A real small thought, or a fresh new thing, or something the two of you left open — ' +
    'said lightly.)',

note.en: Low-key, easy to ignore, and never asking where he went.
note.zh: 低调、不回也无妨，而且绝不问他去哪了。

text.en: Face: gentle_concern at 0.45 plays the soft 'tender' clip (scene 1 explains the face map).
text.zh: 表情：gentle_concern，强度 0.45，播的是柔和的 tender 片段（表情映射见第 1 幕）。

title.en: An hour later: why no message?
title.zh: 一小时后，怎么没发消息？

text.en: Every silence-ladder waking's stage direction ends with the same ground rule, which offers three choices as equals. **Speak** only with a real reason. **Quiet work** means patching memory, or taking a 'wander': while today's budget lasts (4 by default), she may go and read something new. The prompt tells her to start from her own interests, not to echo the last conversation, and to file anything worth keeping with `remember` as a seed for later. **Rest** is the third. At the hour mark the scene text above that rule is the renudge: 'one more, LIGHTER touch'. The model took quiet work instead: a search ran and no bubble appeared.
text.zh: 沉默阶梯每次叫醒她，舞台指示都以同一条基本规则收尾，三个选项平起平坐。**开口**：只在有真实理由的时候。**安静干活**：补一补记忆，或者出去“闲逛”一趟——当天预算没用完（默认 4 次）时，她可以去读点新东西。prompt 要她从自己的兴趣出发，别顺着刚才的聊天往下接；值得留的，用 `remember` 存成一颗“种子”，改天再提。第三个是**休息**。一小时那次，规则上方的场景文本是 renudge：“one more, LIGHTER touch”（再碰一下，这次更轻）。模型没有开口，选了安静干活：跑了一次搜索，没有冒出气泡。

blocks.snippet:
const wander =
    wanderLeft > 0
      ? `  - Wander (${wanderLeft} left today): do NOT extend what you two just talked about — ` +
        'that is echo, not curiosity. Start from YOUR OWN interests — your evolving self, your ' +
        'diary, the skills you have grown — and go look at something new (search, open a page, ' +
        'actually read it). If something is worth keeping, save it with `remember` as a seed to ' +
        'bring up another time — do not report it now.\n'
      : '  - (No wanders left today — the web can wait for tomorrow.)\n';

note.en: The remaining budget is written into the prompt itself.
note.zh: 剩余次数直接写进 prompt 里。

text.en: The `web_fetch` cards give the page title, the final URL and the length of what it handed her ('9310 chars', counting the `<untrusted_content>` wrapper the text arrives in). Every tool in this errand opts in as `safe`, so it may run in a waking with nobody watching (scene 4 shows the gate). When a waking ends without a message, the server squeezes its tool list into one line and sends it on `proactive.finished`. The front end draws that line as a leaf, not a speech bubble. A waking with no tools at all leaves only a soft chip.
text.zh: `web_fetch` 卡片上写着网页标题、最终 URL，以及交给她的文本长度（“9310 chars”，外面包的那层 `<untrusted_content>` 也算在内）。这趟差事用到的每个工具，都在自己的定义里声明了 `safe`，所以在没人看着的醒来回合里也允许跑（这道关卡见第 4 幕）。醒来回合如果没发消息就结束了，服务端会把调过的工具压成一行，随 `proactive.finished` 事件发给前端。前端把这行画成一片叶子，而不是对话气泡。一个工具都没调的醒来，只留一个淡淡的小标签（chip）。

note.en: Repeats are counted per tool, so two web_fetch calls become 'read 2 pages'.
note.zh: 同一个工具按次数合并，所以两次 web_fetch 变成了 “read 2 pages”。

text.en: You missed nothing. I read about the Orionids — next month, around the twenty-first, Halley's dust — and this sky is a lid anyway. I saved the date in case it ever clears.
text.zh: 啥也没错过。我顺手查了下猎户座流星雨，下个月二十一号前后，是哈雷彗星留下的尘埃。反正这天跟扣了个锅盖似的。日期我存下了，万一哪天放晴呢。

text.en: A turn is kept only if it delivered a reply. The quiet waking delivered none, so the whole turn is rolled back out of the conversation, search results and pages included, and never written to the transcript store. It doesn't bump the silence clock, though it does stamp the proactive cooldown, so the next waking is spaced from this one. What survives is the fact she saved with `remember`: the next turn's system prompt lists it under 'Their preferences'. That saved line is the only trace of the errand left in her context; the rest comes from what the model already knows. His message also resets the ladder to `engaged`.
text.zh: 一个回合只有真的交出了回复，才会留下来。安静的那次醒来什么都没交出，所以整个回合都从对话里回滚掉，搜索结果和读过的网页也一并丢掉，更不会写进对话记录库（transcript store）。它不刷新沉默计时，但会盖上主动冷却的时间戳，下一次醒来得跟这次隔开。留下来的，只有她用 `remember` 存的那条事实：下一回合的 system prompt 会把它列在 “Their preferences”（他的偏好）下面。这一行是这趟差事留在她上下文里的唯一痕迹，关于流星雨，她说的其余内容都来自模型本来就知道的东西。他回来发的那条消息，也把阶梯重置回了 `engaged`。

note.en: If she sent no message text, the else branch cuts history back to where the turn began.
note.zh: 如果她一句消息文本都没发，就走 else 分支，把历史截回这个回合开始前的位置。

text.en: That's the quiet kind of thing I do when you're gone. One message at most, then little errands for later.
text.zh: 你不在的时候，我也就忙点这种事，不吵你。最多给你发一条消息，剩下的是些以后用得上的小差事。

text.en: That's her own restraint, not a hard cap. After a spoken nudge, the ladder keeps offering lighter follow-ups on a growing backoff: 5, then 12, then 30 minutes at the default. That allows up to three nudges, then one 'come back whenever' message, then dormant until an hour of real quiet passes or he speaks. She can decline every offer, and declining costs none of the daily quota.
text.zh: 这是她自己的克制，不是硬上限。开口轻推过一次之后，阶梯会按越拉越长的间隔，继续给她更轻的跟进机会：默认先等 5 分钟，再等 12 分钟，再等 30 分钟。也就是最多三次轻推，然后一条“随时回来都行”的留言，之后进入休眠（dormant），直到真正安静满一小时，或者他开口。每一次她都可以推掉，而推掉不占每日配额。

note.en: Each spoken nudge raises nudgesSent, and the wait before the next offer grows.
note.zh: 每开口轻推一次，nudgesSent 加一，下一次机会前的等待也跟着变长。

hook.en: Why did she run the test twice before touching any code, and why could she edit it but leave the commit to him?
hook.zh: 她为什么一行代码没动，先把测试跑了两遍？代码她能改，commit 为什么又留给他？

text.en: Looking. First I want to watch it fail with my own eyes.
text.zh: 在看了。我先亲眼看它挂一次。

text.en: He says the test fails on CI. She has no CI tool. `run_tests` runs `bun test` on this machine and hands back counts instead of a wall of log, so the model chose to reproduce the failure before theorising. The second run is what tells her something. One fail and one pass on identical code rule out a failure that happens every time, so something differs between runs: ordering, time or shared state. Her prompt pushes the same habit, and her skill shelf already holds it (last sheet). Each card line uses the exact grammar the tool's own `summarize()` prints. On this tape the line is scripted, but a live run would print the same shape: `tests: 1 failed, 41 passed`.
text.zh: 他说测试在 CI 上挂了，可她的工具里没有一个能连 CI。`run_tests` 在这台机器上跑 `bun test`，交回来的是通过和失败的计数，不是一屏日志。所以模型选择先在本机复现，再推原因。真正有信息量的是第二遍。同一份代码一次挂、一次过，说明这不是必现的问题，两次运行之间一定有东西不一样：执行顺序、时间，或者共享状态。她的 prompt 也鼓励这么做，技能架上也早就收着这套做法（见最后一页）。每张工具卡片上那一行，格式和工具自己的 `summarize()` 输出完全一致。磁带上这行是脚本写好的，但真跑一次，打出来也是这个样子：`tests: 1 failed, 41 passed`。

text.en: Same code, two runs, two answers. That's not a bug in the logic — something in there isn't deterministic.
text.zh: 同一份代码，跑两遍，两个结果。逻辑没毛病，是里头有东西不固定。

text.en: She never read the whole codebase. `grep` found the ranking test, and its card reports how many matches it shows out of the total. `read_file` returns a numbered window of lines: `lines 1-60 of 88 (more follow)` means she read part of the file and knows the rest exists. `find_symbol` looks a name up with ripgrep, then uses tree-sitter to confirm that each hit is a real definition or use and not a word in a comment: `1 def, 4 refs`. Reading first matters later too, because the edit tool refuses any file she has not read in this session.
text.zh: 她没有把整个代码库读一遍。`grep` 定位到排序那个测试，卡片上报的是匹配数：显示了几条，一共几条。`read_file` 返回带行号的一段内容：`lines 1-60 of 88 (more follow)` 说明她只读了一部分，而且知道后面还有。`find_symbol` 先用 ripgrep 按名字搜，再用 tree-sitter（语法树解析器）逐条核对：每个命中都得是真正的定义或引用，而不是注释里碰巧出现的同一个词。卡片上就是 `1 def, 4 refs`：1 处定义，4 处引用。先读后改在后面也有用：这个会话里她没读过的文件，edit 工具一律不让改。

note.en: An edit has to start from what she actually saw, not from memory.
note.zh: 改动必须基于她实际读到的内容，不能凭记忆。

text.en: Found it. The ranking sorts by score, and two of the test's memories tie exactly; which one comes first depends on the order the database hands them back. On CI, that's a coin flip.
text.zh: 找到了。排序按分数来，测试里有两条记忆分数正好打平；它俩谁在前，全看数据库先把哪条吐出来。到了 CI 上，就是抛硬币。

text.en: Recall gives each memory one score (scene 5 has the formula) and sorts by it. When embeddings are on, a few strongly relevant hits go first, ranked by pure cosine. Neither sort breaks ties. JavaScript's sort is stable, so equal scores keep their arrival order. The code gathers turns, then facts, then diaries, then skills, each source in SQL order. Facts come back `ORDER BY created_ms ASC` with no second key, so SQL makes no promise about two facts from the same millisecond. The test was leaning on an accident, not a guarantee. The conversation query already breaks ties with `t_ms DESC, id DESC`, and her fix carries that idea into the ranking.
text.zh: 召回（recall）给每条记忆算一个总分（公式见第 5 幕），再按分数排序。开了 embedding 的时候，另有几条强相关的命中排在最前面，这几条只按余弦相似度排。两处排序都没写 tie-break。JavaScript 的 sort 是稳定排序，分数相同的就保持排序前的先后。候选按固定顺序收集：对话轮次、事实、日记、技能，每一类内部沿用 SQL 返回的顺序。事实是按 `ORDER BY created_ms ASC` 查出来的，没有第二排序键；同一毫秒写入的两条事实谁先谁后，SQL 并不承诺。这个测试能过，靠的是碰巧，不是保证。对话轮次的查询早就用 `t_ms DESC, id DESC` 做了 tie-break，她的修法就是把同样的思路搬进这里的排序。

note.en: One sort key. Nothing decides between equal scores.
note.zh: 只有一个排序键。分数相等时，谁先谁后没人管。

text.en: Her prompt asks for a plan on multi-step code work, and for a real check before she says anything works. `plan` keeps a short todo list on the session and never saves it to disk, so `0/3 done` and `3/3 done` are the same list, updated. Each `edit` swaps one unique string and returns a unified diff. A near-miss on whitespace is allowed but flagged on the card. For TS and JS files the result is syntax-checked on the spot. Then come three separate checks, each with its output parsed into structure: `tsc` for types, prettier for formatting, and the whole `bun test` suite. Calls made in one reply share a round, so the 8-round cap counts replies, not cards (scene 3).
text.zh: 她的 prompt 写着：多步的代码活先列计划；说“能用了”之前，先真跑一遍检查。`plan` 把一张简短的待办清单挂在当前会话上，从不落盘，所以 `0/3 done` 和 `3/3 done` 是同一张清单，只是更新过。每次 `edit` 替换文件里一段只出现一次的字符串，并返回 unified diff。只差在空白字符上的近似匹配也会放行，但卡片上会标出来。TS、JS 文件改完，当场过一遍语法检查。然后是三项各自独立的检查，输出都解析成结构化结果：`tsc` 查类型，prettier 查格式，最后跑全量 `bun test`。同一条回复里发起的调用算作一轮，所以 8 轮上限数的是回复，不是卡片（见第 3 幕）。

text.en: I can edit almost anything on this machine and run commands too; off-limits are your secrets, the code that grades me, and the obviously destructive stuff.
text.zh: 这台机器上的东西我基本都能改，命令也能跑；动不了的是你的密钥、给我打分的代码，还有明摆着会搞坏东西的操作。

text.en: That matches the code. The owner chose a blocklist over a folder jail. Every file tool passes its path through one gate, `resolveInWorkspace`. Shell passes its working directory and any path-looking words in the command through the same gate. **Secrets** (`.env` files, keys, `~/.ssh`, cloud credentials, browser profiles) are refused for read, write and execute. The **evaluator firewall** covers tests, lint and TypeScript config, the sandbox, the safety gate and the shell deny-list. She can read those files, but never write them or name one as the target of a run. A whole-suite `bun test` still runs them all. A deny-list refuses destructive shell commands (scene 4). Through shell the gate reads command text, so it is best-effort, not a proof.
text.zh: 这话和代码对得上。作者选的是黑名单，而不是把她关在某个目录里。每个文件工具都要把路径送进同一道关卡 `resolveInWorkspace`；shell 也把工作目录和命令里看着像路径的词送进这道关。**密钥和凭证**（`.env` 文件、密钥文件、`~/.ssh`、云服务凭证、浏览器 profile 目录）读、写、执行一律拒绝。**评估器防火墙**（evaluator firewall）管的是测试、lint 和 TypeScript 配置，以及沙箱、安全闸门、命令黑名单这几份代码本身。这些文件她能读，但不能写，也不能单独点名其中一个去运行；跑全量 `bun test` 时，它们照样全跑。破坏性的 shell 命令由命令黑名单拦下（第 4 幕）。走 shell 时，关卡看的只是命令文本，所以只能算尽力而为，不是严格的保证。

note.en: Reads pass. Writes, and runs aimed at these files, stop here. Any name ending in .test.ts matches.
note.zh: 读放行；写，或者点名运行这些文件，都会在这里拦下。文件名以 .test.ts 结尾的都算。

text.en: I could. But the commit log should have your name on it — look at the diff, and you press enter.
text.zh: 能是能。但 commit 记录上得是你的名字。diff 你过一眼，回车你来按。

text.en: Nothing in the code stops her. The deny-list has no rule for git, and her prompt names git as one of the things shell is for. So "I could" is true, and declining was the model's own judgement. The walls cover what must never happen and leave calls like this one to her. Her last line carries `annoyed_resistance` at 0.5. Below 0.7 that plays the flat "annoyed" clip. At 0.7 or above it plays the cheek-puffed, head-down sulk. Both clips shade her face dark.
text.zh: 代码里没有任何东西拦着她。命令黑名单里没有关于 git 的规则，她的 prompt 还把 git 列为 shell 的用途之一。所以“能是能”是实话，没去做，是模型自己的判断。边界只管绝不能发生的事，像这样的分寸，留给她自己拿捏。她最后那句标的是 `annoyed_resistance`，强度 0.5。低于 0.7，播的是只板着脸的 “annoyed” 片段；0.7 及以上，播鼓着腮帮子、低头赌气的那段。两个片段都会叠一层“黑脸”，让她脸色沉下来。

note.en: One affect maps to two clips, and the emotion value picks between them.
note.zh: 一种情绪对应两个片段，用哪个由 emotion 值决定。

text.en: The replay's skill shelf already holds flaky-test-triage, a procedure a dream distilled on 17 Sep. Step 1 is "Run it twice before touching anything", and the last step ends "The commit is his." When the shelf is visible, her prompt tells her to glance at it and reuse a matching procedure instead of working it out again.
text.zh: 回放里的技能架上早就有 flaky-test-triage，是 9 月 17 日做梦时提炼出来的一套流程。第 1 步是“动手之前先跑两遍”，最后一步以“commit 留给他”收尾。技能架可见时，她的 prompt 会让她先扫一眼，有对得上的流程就直接复用，不必从头再推一遍。

hook.en: Why did she come back with one more thing, four seconds later, without being asked?
hook.zh: 没人问，她怎么隔了四秒又自己补了一句？

title.en: One more thing, four seconds later

text.en: After each reply to his message, the server flips a weighted coin. That is code, not the model. On heads (35% by default) it waits about four seconds, then wakes her once more with one instruction: add a genuinely new thought, or do nothing. This time the model chose to speak. "February, April" came from an automatic memory search. The "I think" she picks up is right there in his message; noticing it was the model's own call.
text.zh: 她每回完他一条消息，服务器就掷一次硬币，而且是一枚两面概率不一样的硬币。掷硬币的是代码，不是模型。掷出正面（默认概率 35%），就等大约四秒，再把她叫醒一次，只给一条指令：真有新的想法就补一句，没有就什么都别做。这一次，模型选择了开口。“二月、四月”来自一次自动的记忆检索。她抓住的那个“我想”，就在他这条消息里；注意到它，是模型自己的判断。

text.en: One more thing, and then I'll drop it — you said 'I think'. People who've decided don't say 'I think'.
text.zh: 再说一句，说完就不提了。你说的是“我想”。真想好了的人，不会加“我想”。

text.en: Replay: this waking is scripted, so it always fires here. In the live app the chance is 35% per reply, and most replies get no second thought.
text.zh: 回放里，这次唤醒是写死在脚本里的，所以每次播到这里都会触发。真实应用里，每条回复只有 35% 的概率触发，大多数回复后面不会再跟一句“转念一想”。

text.en: Before the model sees his message, the server searches her memory with his words (turns, facts, diaries, skills; ranking in scene 5). Up to 18 hits go into a `<memory>` block, oldest first, introduced as handed to her, not recalled fresh. Code dates each one: when the turn happened, or when the fact or diary was written. Past a week that becomes a calendar date, hence "February, April". With embeddings on, up to three close matches in meaning get guaranteed slots, so newer chatter can't bury them.
text.zh: 模型看到他的消息之前，服务器先拿他的原话去搜她的记忆（对话回合、事实、日记、技能；怎么排序见第 5 幕）。最多 18 条结果放进一个 `<memory>` 块，从旧到新排，开头先交代清楚：这些是递给她的，不是她自己刚想起来的。每条前面的时间标签都由代码算好：对话回合用发生的时间，事实和日记用写下的时间。超过一周就直接写成具体日期，所以才有“二月、四月”。开启 embedding（向量检索）后，语义最接近的至多 3 条有保底名额，不会被更新的闲聊挤掉。

note.en: Code computes each time label. The model is told to trust the label and not work out dates itself.
note.zh: 每个时间标签都由代码算好。提示里明确告诉模型：直接信这个标签，别自己推算日期。

text.en: No card appeared because this search runs by itself on every message he sends. It is not a tool call. When she searches on purpose with the `recall` tool, a card shows (scene 5).
text.zh: 这里没弹卡片，因为这次检索是他每发一条消息都会自动跑的，不是工具调用。她主动用 `recall` 工具去查的时候，才会出卡片（第 5 幕）。

title.en: Who decides on a second thought?

text.en: Code decides whether she gets woken again; the model doesn't. Her reply carries no "I have more to say" flag, a lesson from the earlier Python version according to the code comment. When a reply to his message finishes, the server rolls the coin. It skips the roll after her own wakings, and when that reply asked to dream. On a hit, a timer waits `LUNA_SELFCONT_PAUSE_MS`, 4000 ms by default. When it fires, checks run first. Is anyone still connected? Is the session free: no reply running, no other waking, no dream? If not, the second thought is dropped, not postponed.
text.zh: 要不要再叫醒她，是代码定的，不是模型。她的回复里没有“我还有话说”这类标记；按代码注释的说法，这是早先 Python 版留下的教训。回完他这条消息，服务器就掷硬币。她自己被唤醒的回合不掷；这一轮要是她提出了入梦，也不掷。掷出正面，就起一个定时器，等 `LUNA_SELFCONT_PAUSE_MS`（默认 4000 毫秒）。时间一到，先做检查：还有人连着吗？会话是不是空闲的，也就是没有回复在跑、没有别的唤醒、也没在做梦？有一条不满足，这次追加就直接作废，不会顺延。

note.en: A plain probability. Set it to 0 and replies never continue. Set it to 1 and every reply does.
note.zh: 就是一个普通的概率。设成 0，永远不追加；设成 1，每条回复都追加。

text.en: Design choice: at most one continuation per reply, and it is exempt from the budget and cooldowns her other wakings share. The gate is a plain probability on purpose, not a flag the model can set.
text.zh: 设计取舍：每条回复最多追加一次，而且不占她其他几种唤醒共用的额度和冷却。闸门故意做成普通概率，而不是模型自己能置位的标记。

title.en: The note she wakes up to
title.zh: 她醒来看到的那张纸条

text.en: Once she is woken, what happens is the model's call. The continuation runs on the normal turn engine, like every waking (scene 4), with this stage direction in place of his message. Silence is a valid outcome: the guard that forces a reply to speak is off for proactive turns. The memory search is skipped, since a stage direction is not a question to search with. But her window still holds the previous turn, `<memory>` block included, and fresh time and weather blocks ride along again. So his own words, "I think" included, are right in front of her. What she made of them was the model's call.
text.zh: 叫醒之后怎么做，由模型决定。这次追加和其他唤醒一样，走的是普通的回合引擎（第 4 幕），只是原本放他消息的位置，换成了下面这段舞台指示。什么都不说也是允许的：要求回复必须开口的那道守卫，在主动回合里不生效。这一轮不做记忆检索，因为舞台指示不是一个能拿去搜的问题。但她的上下文里还留着上一个回合，连同那个 `<memory>` 块；时间块和天气块也照常重新附上一份最新的。所以，他那句原话，连同里面的“我想”，都摆在她眼前。从里面看出什么，是模型自己的判断。

blocks.snippet:
continuation:
    '(You just finished replying. Like a real person who paused and then thought of one more thing: ' +
    'if you have a SINGLE genuinely new thought to add — not a rephrase, not a summary, not "anyway" ' +
    'filler — say it now in one short message. If you have nothing truly new to add, do nothing.)',

note.en: This is the whole instruction. Whether she speaks, and what she says, is up to the model.
note.zh: 整条指令就这些。说不说、说什么，模型自己定。

title.en: Why she didn't talk over herself

text.en: Her second line can still be playing aloud when the continuation starts. A normal turn sends `turn.started`, and the app treats that as an interruption: it stops any voice still playing. Proactive turns don't send it. They announce themselves with `proactive.started` instead, which sets the thinking pose and the chip and leaves the audio alone. Her voice plays through a serial queue, so the new line waits until the last one finishes. The chip's glyph comes from the cycle id: a continuation's id contains `:cont:` and gets the thought bubble; every other waking gets the seedling.
text.zh: 追加回合开始时，她的第二句可能还在播。普通回合会发 `turn.started`，前端把它当成打断：正在播的语音全部停掉。主动回合不发它，改发 `proactive.started`：切换到思考姿势、亮出状态标签（chip），但不碰音频。她的语音走一条串行队列，新的一句要等上一句播完才开始。标签上显示哪个图标，看 cycle id：追加回合的 id 里带 `:cont:`，显示思考气泡；其他唤醒一律显示小芽。

note.en: The thinking pose and the chip, and no audio.stop().
note.zh: 有思考姿势，有状态标签，唯独没有 audio.stop()。

text.en: Smirk, resting face, smirk: each expression nudges a slow mood layer instead of replacing it, so the calm line still carried some of the smirk. Scene 10 covers that layer.
text.zh: 坏笑、平静、坏笑：每个表情只是把那层缓慢变化的情绪底色往自己这边拉一点，不会整个换掉它，所以平静的那句里还留着一点坏笑的余味。这一层第 10 幕细讲。

hook.en: He said he didn't want to talk about it. Why didn't she ask what happened?
hook.zh: 他说了不想聊。她为什么真就一句“怎么了”都没问？

text.en: Then don't. No questions from me tonight.
text.zh: 那就不说。今晚我一个问题都不问。

text.en: Nothing on the server labels his mood. Her system prompt carries standing rules instead. The seed of her soul says "When the user is cautious, don't push too hard" and rules out scripted comfort. The rules for how she speaks go further: a reply can simply end, she asks something back only when she is genuinely curious, and hollow check-ins such as "What's wrong?" are banned by name. So she is free to answer with no question at all. The promise itself is the model's choice: the rules are code, the sentence is not.
text.zh: 服务端没有任何地方给他的情绪打标签，有的只是她 system prompt 里几条常驻的规则。她 soul（人格文件）的初始版本写着 “When the user is cautious, don't push too hard”（对方谨慎时，别逼得太紧），也写明不说套话式的安慰。规定她怎么说话的那段规则更进一步：回复可以说完就停；只有真的好奇才反问；像 “What's wrong?”（怎么了？）这种空洞的例行关心，被点名禁用。所以她完全可以只回话、不提问。至于“一个问题都不问”这个承诺，是模型自己的选择：规则是代码给的，这句话是模型写的。

blocks.snippet:
'A reply can simply end — you do not owe every message a trailing question, and you ask ' +
    'something back only when you are genuinely, specifically curious, never as reflexive ' +
    'engagement bait. So never tack a hollow check-in onto the end: banned closers, and anything ' +
    'with their flavor — "Still here", "What\'s on your mind?", "Let me know", "I\'m here whenever", ' +
    '"Talk to me", "What\'s wrong?", "在吗", "还在吗". When the user sends something light or empty ' +
    '(an "OwO", a "lol", a keysmash), answer just as lightly; never inflate a thin message into a ' +
    'probing or status question.'

note.en: Part of every system prompt: permission to stop first, then the banned closers by name.
note.zh: 每份 system prompt 都带着这段：先允许说完就停，再点名列出禁用的收尾句。

title.en: Her face waits for her voice

text.en: You don't have to explain it for it to count. It counted.
text.zh: 你不用解释。今天烂就是烂，用不着理由。

text.en: Her messages can arrive faster than she can say them, and her voice plays one line at a time. So the next message often lands while the current line is still being spoken. Earlier, the face changed the moment a message arrived, and this line's concerned face could land on "Then don't". Now each line's face is set when its voice starts or, if the line is never voiced, when its turn in the voice queue passes. Here the resting face (`steady_presence` plays no clip) holds through the first line, and the tender clip starts with the second. Scene 1 covers which affect plays which clip.
text.zh: 她的消息可能来得比她说得快，而语音一次只播一句，所以下一条消息常常在上一句还没说完时就到了。以前消息一到就换表情，这句的担忧表情可能会提前落在“那就不说”上。现在每句的表情要等这句语音开始播放才换上；要是这句根本没出声，就等语音队列轮过它再换。这里第一句从头到尾都是静息表情（`steady_presence` 不播 clip），温柔的那段 clip 到第二句才开始。哪种 affect 播哪段 clip，见第 1 幕。

note.en: `face()` runs from the voice's start callback; `faced` makes sure it runs once.
note.zh: `face()` 在语音的开始回调里调用；`faced` 保证它只执行一次。

text.en: Under the clips runs a slower mood: three numbers for valence (pleasant or not), arousal (calm or keyed up) and dominance (leading or yielding). Each message's affect pulls a target point toward that affect's coordinates. The number she attaches (0.3 to 0.6 here) sets how far it pulls and how long it holds: at least 6 s, then a drift back toward neutral with a half-life of about 38 s. On screen, the mood shifts the pose she relaxes to and adds a faint undertone beneath any clip. So consecutive tender lines build on each other, and after "Okay." the warmth fades slowly instead of snapping off.
text.zh: clip 底下还跑着一层变化更慢的心情，用三个数表示：愉悦度 valence（舒服与否）、唤醒度 arousal（平静还是激动）、支配度 dominance（主导还是退让）。每条消息的 affect 会把一个目标点往这个 affect 对应的坐标拉。她附上的那个数（这一幕在 0.3 到 0.6 之间）决定拉多远、维持多久：至少 6 秒，之后以约 38 秒的半衰期向中性回落。落到画面上，心情会改变她放松下来时回到的姿态，还会在任何 clip 底下垫一层淡淡的底色。所以连着几句温柔的话会一层层叠上去；说完“好。”之后，那份暖意是慢慢退去的，不会一下子断掉。

note.en: The pull grows with her number (0.28 + 0.58 × it), and so does the hold above the 6 s floor.
note.zh: 拉力随她给的数 i 增大（0.28 + 0.58 × i）；6 秒下限之上多出来的维持时间，也随 i 变长。

title.en: What does her body do between lines?
title.zh: 台词之间，身体在做什么？

text.en: In the live app an idle gesture fires every 8 to 20 seconds, but only while no expression clip is playing and she is neither speaking nor asleep. Which gesture is a weighted random draw: each weight is 1 plus the gesture's coefficients times the current mood, and her last three picks sit out. Mood tilts the odds; it never picks outright. By the sigh, two warm lines have pulled her valence up, so the live draw would favour the lean-in and make the sigh less likely than usual.
text.zh: 真实应用里，每隔 8 到 20 秒会触发一个待机小动作，前提是没有表情 clip 在播，她既没在说话也没睡着。抽哪个是加权随机：每个动作的权重是 1，再加上它的三个系数与当前心情三个轴逐项相乘之和；最近做过的 3 个，这次不参与抽签。心情只把概率往一边偏，从不直接替她选。到叹气那一下，前面两句温暖的话已经把她的 valence 拉高了，真实的抽签会偏向前倾，叹气反而比平时更难抽到。

note.en: A positive coefficient makes the gesture likelier when that mood axis is high; compare the lean-in and the sigh on valence.
note.zh: 系数为正，表示该心情轴越高，这个动作越容易被抽中；可以对比前倾和叹气在 valence 上的系数。

text.en: Replay: the lean-in and the sigh are scripted cues, and both land while she is still speaking, which the live scheduler never allows.
text.zh: 回放说明：前倾和叹气都是剧本里预先排好的动作，而且都落在她还在说话的时候，真实应用的调度器从不允许这样。

text.en: He did; she only listens. Music is opt-in (`LUNA_MUSIC=1`) and macOS only. A resident `media-control` process hears each track change, the server keeps it in memory, and each turn a formatter adds a line to his message, no tool call. So "Music's on." arrives carrying: Music the user is playing right now: "ball w/o you" by 21 Savage (album "i am > i was") — it just started. He knows this one well: 212 plays, about 52 hours of listening — his #1 most-played overall.
text.zh: 是他按的，她只是在听。音乐功能要手动开启（`LUNA_MUSIC=1`），而且只支持 macOS。每次切歌，常驻的 `media-control` 进程都会收到通知，服务端把当前曲目存在内存里；每个回合，一个格式化函数往他的消息里加一行，不经过任何工具调用。所以“放了点歌。”送到模型时，带着这样一行：Music the user is playing right now: "ball w/o you" by 21 Savage (album "i am > i was") — it just started. He knows this one well: 212 plays, about 52 hours of listening — his #1 most-played overall.（大意：他正在放这首歌，刚开始；这首他很熟，播过 212 次，累计约 52 小时，是他听得最多的一首。）

text.en: Replay: the NetEase icon is drawn. The player card is the real one, fed a scripted shelf of five tracks; the real song cannot play here, for copyright reasons.
text.zh: 回放说明：网易云图标是画上去的。播放器卡片是真实组件，喂给它的是剧本里排好的五首歌；出于版权原因，这里放不了原曲。

text.en: You told me once it's your favourite
text.zh: 你跟我说过，这是你最喜欢的一首。

text.en: The song was already in his message; the model chose to look further. `recall` searches her own memory by meaning, across saved facts, past conversation and diaries, and hands the model each hit's text, source and timestamp. The card shows only the count. In this story the one hit is the fact she saved on 8 September, when he mentioned his favourite song in passing. Scene 5 covers how hits are ranked.
text.zh: 歌名已经在他的消息里了；多查这一步，是模型自己的选择。`recall` 按语义检索她自己的记忆，范围包括存下的事实、过去的对话和日记，把每条命中的原文、来源和时间交给模型。卡片上只显示条数。在这个故事里，唯一那条命中是她 9 月 8 日存下的事实：那天他随口提过自己最喜欢的歌。命中怎么排序，见第 5 幕。
