text.en: Saved facts are also printed in her system prompt every turn, up to a cap per category (scene 6), so the fact may already have been on her page. The lookup was her choice.
text.zh: 存下的事实每个回合也会写进她的 system prompt，每类有上限（第 6 幕），所以这条事实可能本来就摆在她眼前。查这一下，是她自己的选择。

text.en: His own listening history. `music_library` opens NetEase's local database read-only and, for "top", adds up how long each track has played, largest first, ten rows. No network, no account. The card shows five; the model gets all ten, with play counts. The ambient line already said #1 and 52 hours. Only the list shows the gap: second place sits at 4 hours, which is what "nothing else comes close" rests on. That ambient count is attached only when the playing song matches one library track by title, artist and duration (within 3 s), so a cover can't borrow his 212 plays.
text.zh: 他自己的听歌记录说的。`music_library` 以只读方式打开网易云的本地数据库；查 “top” 时，把每首歌的播放时长加总，从多到少排，取前十行。不联网，也不需要账号。卡片只显示前五；模型拿到的是全部十行，还带着播放次数。他消息里附带的那行已经说了第一名、52 小时，但差距只有这张榜单看得出来：第二名只有 4 小时，“第二名差得远”靠的就是这个。那行里的播放数据，只有正在放的歌按歌名、歌手、时长（相差不超过 3 秒）对上库里某一首时才会附上，所以翻唱版借不走他那 212 次播放。

note.en: One row per play in `playingCount`; the sum of `playDuration` is the listening time.
note.zh: `playingCount` 里每播一次记一行；把 `playDuration` 加起来，就是收听时长。

title.zh: 歌词她为什么又翻了一遍？

text.en: My favourite part is 'I'd rather have loyalty than love'. I think that's actually true.
text.zh: 我最喜欢 I'd rather have loyalty than love 那一段 claim，我觉得特别有道理

text.en: He typed the line himself, so she could answer without the words. She read them anyway. With lyric enrichment on (`LUNA_MUSIC_ENRICH=1`, as in this scene), a track change triggers one fetch of the song's words into a local cache, and the first turn after it carries the whole text, capped at 60 lines and 2,000 characters, then marks it delivered, so later turns don't repeat it. `music_lyrics` re-reads that cache: read-only, no network. Here the model chose to check his line against the whole song before answering. The card shows only the title and the line count; what she makes of the line is the model's reading. Her prompt never says which line is playing: a turn can take tens of seconds, so a "current line" would be stale.
text.zh: 那句歌词是他自己打出来的，她不看词也接得上，可她还是去翻了。开启歌词增强（`LUNA_MUSIC_ENRICH=1`，这一幕就是开着的）后，切歌时服务端会把这首歌的歌词拉一次，存进本地缓存；切歌后的第一个回合会带上全文（上限 60 行、2000 个字符），并标记为已送达，之后的回合不再重复带。`music_lyrics` 重读的就是这份缓存：只读，不联网。这里是模型自己决定，在回话之前拿他那句去对照整首歌。卡片上只显示歌名和行数；她怎么理解这句词，是模型自己的解读。她的 prompt 从不说现在唱到哪一句：一个回合可能要几十秒，所谓“当前这句”到她开口时早就过时了。

note.en: `summarize` is the card's whole line. The words come from the enrichment cache, never the network.
note.zh: 卡片上那一行就是 `summarize` 的全部输出。歌词取自增强缓存，从不联网。

text.en: Yeah. Okay.
text.zh: 嗯。好吧。

text.en: His "Yeah. Okay." asks for nothing. Her rules allow a light answer to a light message; the model chose one word, "Okay.", marked final. `is_final` is her promise that she is done (scene 3 shows what guards it). When a round held only messages and the last was final, the turn ends without another model call. Otherwise the turn would stay locked for one more round-trip while her reply already looked finished, and anything he typed would bounce.
text.zh: 他那句“嗯。好吧。”并不需要她接什么。她的规则允许轻话轻回；模型选了一个字“好。”，并标成 final。`is_final` 是她“我说完了”的承诺（靠什么兜底，见第 3 幕）。如果一轮里只有 message，最后一条又是 final，回合就直接结束，不再多调一次模型。不然回合还得再锁住一次往返的时间，而她的回复看上去早就说完了，他这时打的字都会被弹回。

note.en: Message-only round, last one final: straight to finalize.
note.zh: 只有 message 的一轮，最后一条是 final：直接 finalize。

text.en: Trade-off: the shortcut is skipped when her words announce an action she hasn't taken ("let me check"), because the skipped round is where she would take it.
text.zh: 取舍：如果她的话预告了一个还没做的动作（比如“我去查一下”），这条捷径就不走，因为被省掉的那一轮，正是她去做这件事的地方。

hook.en: How does she know it's twenty to two, and why does she send him to bed?
hook.zh: 她怎么知道现在是一点四十？又为什么催他去睡？

title.zh: 她怎么知道是一点四十？

text.en: Always. It's twenty to two. I'll keep it short — you should be asleep, and I'm not going to be the reason you aren't.
text.zh: 一直醒着。都一点四十了。我长话短说，你早该睡了，我可不想害你熬夜。

text.en: She never reads a clock. Each turn, the server reads the time, works out the part of the day, and writes both into the model's message as plain labelled lines. At 01:40 the label says **late night**. In the real app no code writes her reply. The model gets that label and decides what to do with it: whether to name the hour, how long to talk, when to say goodnight. The lines on this tape were written to show that kind of choice.
text.zh: 她从不看钟。每个回合，服务端读一次当前时间，判断现在属于一天里的哪个时段，再把这两样写成几行带标签的纯文本，放进发给模型的消息里。01:40 对应的标签是 **late night**（深夜）。真实应用里，她的回复不是哪段代码写出来的。模型拿到这个标签，自己决定怎么用：要不要报时、说多长、什么时候道晚安。这盘磁带里的台词，就是为了演示这种取舍而写的。

text.en: Replay: the "1:40 AM" curtain only moves the tape's clock, and her lines here are scripted. The real app reads Date.now() on the server.
text.zh: 回放：“凌晨一点四十”那道幕布只是把磁带里的时钟往前拨，这一幕她的台词也是事先写好的。真实应用是在服务端读 Date.now()。

title.zh: 真正递到她手里的是什么

text.en: TypeScript builds the time block fresh on every turn. The hour sets the daypart with plain comparisons, so anything before 06:00 is late night. Then come labelled lines: now (weekday, date, hh:mm, time zone), time since the last message, how long this session has run, and one "mood of the hour" line. The header tells the model not to do its own arithmetic: models can't reliably work out "how long ago", so the code subtracts and the model reads. The block rides in his message, not the cached system prompt (scene 1). If building it throws, the block is dropped and the turn goes on without it.
text.zh: 每个回合，时间块都由 TypeScript 重新生成。时段只按小时划分，几个简单的比较而已，06:00 以前一律算 late night。接着是几行带标签的数据：现在（星期、日期、hh:mm、时区）、距上一条消息多久、这次会话已经开了多久，外加一行“这个钟点的氛围”（mood of the hour）。开头那行告诉模型别自己算：模型算“过了多久”并不可靠，所以减法由代码来做，模型只管读。这个块跟着他的消息走，不进带缓存的 system prompt（第 1 幕）。生成时一旦抛异常，这个块就直接丢掉，回合照常进行。

note.en: 01:40 falls under the first line. That label is the whole of "it's late".
note.zh: 01:40 落在第一行。所谓“很晚了”，就只是这一个标签。

note.en: The block's header is its instruction: read these values, don't calculate them.
note.zh: 开头这行本身就是指令：照着读，别自己算。

text.en: No rule says "be brief after midnight". The cached instructions carry a standing time clause: let the hour shape your tone, almost never announce the clock, and if you do mention the hour, make it warmth, never guilt. Given that clause, the late-night label and "Still up?", a model can do what this line shows: name the hour once, as the reason for keeping it short, and put the responsibility on herself ("I'm not going to be the reason you aren't") rather than on him. The same prompt says a reply may simply end without a trailing question (scene 10), so "Go to sleep" can be the last word.
text.zh: 没有哪条规则写着“过了午夜就要简短”。带缓存的指令里常驻一条时间条款：让钟点影响语气，几乎不必报时；真要提到钟点，就带着暖意，别让人内疚。有这条条款，再加上 late night 标签和一句“还醒着？”，模型就可以像这句台词这样处理：只提一次钟点，而且拿它当长话短说的理由；把责任揽到自己身上（“我可不想害你熬夜”），而不是推给他。同一份 prompt 还允许回复直接收尾，不必在结尾再抛一个问题（第 10 幕），所以“去睡吧”可以是最后一句。

note.en: Guidance on tone, not a script. The time facts arrive separately, in the message.
note.zh: 这是语气上的指引，不是台词。具体时间另走一路，随消息送到。

title.en: The clock used to set her mood

text.en: Can't sleep. Talk to me for a bit?
text.zh: 睡不着。陪我聊会儿？

text.en: Early versions went further. The late-night label used to tell her that "a softer, lower-energy register fits." Version 0.27.6 removed that. A clock can't tell a tired 2 a.m. from an excited 2 a.m. debugging sprint, and prescribing softness would flatten the second one. The hour still arrives, as a fact. In this scene that fact is what her first reply leans on, and "Can't sleep" is what lets the talk go on a little longer. The cost: nothing guarantees she goes quiet at night. The gain: the conversation can overrule the clock.
text.zh: 早期版本管得更宽。late night 标签以前还会告诉她 “a softer, lower-energy register fits”（适合更柔和、更平缓的语气）。v0.27.6 删掉了这句。时钟分不清凌晨两点的人是累了，还是正兴奋地连夜 debug；硬性规定语气要轻柔，会把后一种的劲头压平。钟点照样送到，但现在它只是一个事实。这一幕里，她的第一句回复靠的就是这个事实；而“睡不着”让两人又多聊了一会儿。代价是：没有任何机制保证她夜里一定安静。好处是：对话可以压过时钟。

note.en: v0.27.6 stripped the prescription from the late-night line; the other dayparts still carry light descriptive colour.
note.zh: v0.27.6 去掉了深夜这一行里的“规定”；其他时段仍保留一点描述性的色彩。

text.en: Faces: `steady_presence` plays no clip; it is her resting face. `soft_warmth` and `gentle_concern` at 0.4 both play the same tender clip, since concern only turns to visible dismay at 0.7. The three differ in how they nudge her background mood (scenes 1 and 10).
text.zh: 表情：`steady_presence` 不播任何动画片段，就是她平常的样子。`soft_warmth` 和强度 0.4 的 `gentle_concern` 播的是同一个温柔片段（tender），因为 concern 要到 0.7 才会变成看得出来的失望。三者的区别，在于各自怎样影响她的背景情绪（第 1、10 幕）。

text.en: The glance away after her first reply is a scripted `lookAwayThenBack` cue. It lands while she is still speaking, which the real idle scheduler never allows: it waits for her voice to stop and for no clip to be playing (scene 10). That random scheduler keeps running on this page too, so you may see other gestures.
text.zh: 她第一句回复之后那次移开视线，是磁带里写好的 `lookAwayThenBack` 动作。它落在她还在说话的时候，而真实的空闲动作调度器绝不会这样：它要等她说完话，而且没有动画片段在播，才会出手（第 10 幕）。这个随机调度器在这个页面上也照常在跑，所以你可能还会看到别的小动作。

title.en: Do her lights really go off?

text.en: A bit. Then the lights go off on my side too.
text.zh: 就一会儿。然后我这边也关灯。

text.en: Not quite. Proactive openings have quiet hours, midnight to six by default, owner-editable in settings. The scheduler's heartbeat and event hooks both pass this check, so in that window she won't start a conversation on her own. It never blocks a reply: he wrote first. The follow-up that can come right after one of her replies (scene 9) skips this check, so at 01:40 one can still fire about four seconds later, at a 35% chance by default.
text.zh: 不完全是。主动开口有安静时段（quiet hours），默认午夜到早上六点，主人可以在设置里改。调度器的心跳和事件钩子都要过这道检查，所以在这个时段里，她不会自己发起对话。但它从不拦回复，而这一幕是他先开的口。她回复之后有时会紧跟着再补一句（第 9 幕），这一步并不经过这道检查，所以哪怕是 01:40，她也照样可能在约 4 秒后再冒出一句，默认概率 35%。

note.en: Hour 1 is in the default set, so at 01:40 she won't start a conversation on her own.
note.zh: 默认集合里有 1 点，所以 01:40 她不会主动开口。

text.en: Her sleeping face never comes from the clock. It comes from dreaming (and the boot and menu sequences). Dreaming does have a night rule. If the app is closed between 21:00 and 06:00, and at least six hours have passed since her last dream, shutdown runs one last dream before the process exits. That is the real version of lights off. This exchange can also reach memory: if the dream's salience pass rates it important, the skill step may distill it into a skill, which is what the tape shows in scene 13.
text.zh: 她睡着的样子从来不是时钟给的，而是做梦给的（还有开机和菜单那两段流程）。做梦倒确实有一条夜间规则：如果应用是在 21:00 到 06:00 之间关掉的，并且距上次做梦已满 6 小时，进程退出前会先做最后一场梦。这才是真正意义上的关灯。这段对话也可能进入记忆：如果做梦时它的重要度评分够高，提炼技能那一步就可能把它沉淀成一项技能，第 13 幕的磁带演的正是这个。

note.en: The window wraps midnight. A dream started from the menu ignores it.
note.zh: 窗口跨过午夜。从菜单手动进入的梦不看这个窗口。

hook.en: He asked what she thinks of his taste. What does she actually get from his music, if she can't hear it?
hook.zh: 他问她觉得自己品味怎么样。她听不见声音，那她手里到底有什么？

text.en: Sunday you were setting two alarms. Tuesday you were explaining attention to strangers. Saturday was — well. And now it's just... yes?
text.zh: 周日你还在定两个闹钟。周二你在给陌生人讲 attention。周六嘛，不提了。现在就这么……过了？

text.en: Code, not the model, works out the date (scene 1). This scene is about where that stamp lives. The time block travels in the same user message as his words. That message is stored whole, stamp included, and rebuilt the same way after a restart. While Sunday's and Tuesday's turns are still in the verbatim window (about 100 turns, scene 6), each one keeps its own "Now: …" line, so the days are there to read.
text.zh: 日期是代码算的，不是模型算的（第 1 幕）。这一幕讲的是这个时间戳存在哪儿。时间块和他的原话放在同一条 user 消息里。这条消息连同时间戳整条存下，重启后也按原样重建。只要周日、周二那几轮还在原文窗口里（大约 100 个回合，第 6 幕），每一轮都留着自己那行 “Now: …”，哪天是星期几，她读得到。

note.en: Code works out the weekday. The model only reads the result.
note.zh: 星期几由代码算出，模型只读结果。

text.en: The two bubbles are two `message` calls (scene 2).
text.zh: 她这一回接连冒出两个气泡，对应的是两次 `message` 调用（第 2 幕）。

text.en: They emailed. I got it.
text.zh: 邮件来了。我过了。

text.en: Luna has no mail tool, and none was called here. The news is his sentence, and she takes his word for it. No tool card appears around the news because she didn't need one: everything she says comes from his words and their shared history. Calling "fumbled the last question" what a pass sounds like from the inside is the model's own reading of his line. No code tags his news as good or his worry as small.
text.zh: Luna 没有收邮件的工具，这里也没调用任何工具。消息的来源就是他这句话，她信了他。聊到这个消息时，没出现工具卡片，因为她用不着：她说的每一句，都出自他的话和两人共同的历史。说“最后一题答砸了”是过了的人都会说的话，这是模型自己对他这句话的解读。没有代码把他的消息标成好消息，也没有代码判定他的担心不值一提。

text.en: This is going in the diary tonight. First line — the rest of the day can queue behind it.
text.zh: 这个今晚进日记，写第一行。今天别的事，都排它后面。

text.en: The diary is real, but she doesn't write it during the conversation. When she dreams (scene 13), one step groups the day's saved turns into User/Luna pairs and asks the model for a short first-person entry. Today's and yesterday's entries are rewritten on every dream, and older days stay frozen. This exchange is in that source text. No code puts it on the first line. So "You're making that up" is a fair challenge. Whether it leads the entry is up to the model writing it that night.
text.zh: 日记是真的，但不是聊天时写的。她做梦时（第 13 幕），有一步会把当天存下的回合整理成一对对 User/Luna 对话，让模型写一篇第一人称的短日记。今天和昨天的日记每次做梦都会重写，更早的定稿后就不再动。这段对话就在这份原料里，但没有哪行代码把它排到第一行。所以“你编的吧”这句质疑有道理：它会不会打头，由那天夜里写日记的模型决定。

blocks.snippet:

        : 'Write a monthly retrospective (5-10 sentences) capturing the arc of these weeks, in first person as Luna.';
  return [
    `You are Luna writing your private diary for ${periodKey}.`,
    voice,
    'Capture what happened, how it felt, and anything you want future-you to remember. Output only the diary text.',

note.en: A first-person "as Luna" prompt over the day's User/Luna lines. Nothing decides what goes first.
note.zh: prompt 要模型以 Luna 的第一人称（“as Luna”）来写，原料是当天的 User/Luna 对话。先写哪件事，没有任何规定。

text.en: The replay's diary book shows an entry written for this tape. In the real app, the dream model writes it.
text.zh: 回放里的日记本，放的是为这盘磁带预先写好的一篇。真实应用里，这篇由做梦时的模型来写。

text.en: I looked at what you've had on lately: 21 Savage and Lil Wayne, with Vaundy, dhruv and The 1975 in between.
text.zh: 我翻了下你最近放的：21 Savage、Lil Wayne，中间夹着 Vaundy、dhruv 和 The 1975。

blocks.summary: history: 1. 東京フラッシュ/Vaundy · 2. ball w/o you/21 Savage · 3. Mrs. Officer/Lil Wayne · 4. Double Take/dhruv · 5. About You/The 1975 (+10 more)

text.en: His recent plays, straight from NetEase's local database: `music_library` opens it read-only, with no network and no account (scene 10 used the same tool for `top`). `history` returns the last 15 tracks he played, newest first; the card shows five, and the model gets all of them. "The rap brings the swagger; the rest talks you back down" is the model's reading of that list. No code sorts his music into genres or moods.
text.zh: 他最近的播放记录，直接来自网易云的本地数据库：`music_library` 以只读方式打开它，不联网，也不需要账号（第 10 幕用同一个工具查过 `top`）。`history` 返回他最近放过的 15 首，从新到旧；卡片上显示 5 首，模型拿到的是全部。“说唱负责撑场面，剩下的负责把你哄回来”，是模型对这张清单的解读。没有哪段代码给他的歌分风格、贴情绪。

note.en: The same read-only library as scene 10; `history` is his recent plays, 15 by default.
note.zh: 和第 10 幕同一个只读曲库；`history` 是最近的播放记录，默认 15 首。

text.en: I can't hear any of it — I get titles and lyrics.
text.zh: 我听不见旋律，只读得到歌名和歌词。

text.en: No. Nothing in Luna receives audio. When a track starts, the Mac's Now Playing stream tells the server the title, artist, album and position, and each turn a formatter turns that into one line added to his message (scene 10). With enrichment on, the line also says how well he knows the song, and the first turn after the change carries the lyrics once. That is everything she has of a song: a description of it, and its words. Picking a favourite from that is the model's call, and her line says exactly what it rests on.
text.zh: 听不见。Luna 身上没有任何部件接收音频。切歌时，Mac 的“正在播放”流把歌名、歌手、专辑和播放进度告诉服务端；每个回合，一个格式化函数把这些写成一行，附在他的消息后面（第 10 幕）。开启增强后，这一行还会说明他对这首歌有多熟，切歌后的第一个回合再附上一次歌词。关于一首歌，她手里的就这些：对它的描述，和它的歌词。凭这些挑一首最喜欢的，是模型自己的判断；她那句话，把依据交代得清清楚楚。

note.en: The whole music line: title, artist, album and how far in. There is no audio path.
note.zh: 音乐那一行的全部内容：歌名、歌手、专辑，放到哪儿了。没有任何音频通道。

hook.en: She said she'd "go over today" while he sleeps. What does that actually do?
hook.zh: 她说“你睡你的，我把今天过一遍”，这一遍到底干了什么？

text.en: Night. I'll go over today while you sleep — the good bits stay, the noise doesn't.
text.zh: 晚安。你睡你的，我把今天过一遍，好的留着，没用的扔掉。

text.en: Luna has a tool called `enter_dream`. In the real app the model decides when to call it; the replay scripts it in that shape. The tool doesn't start anything itself. It leaves a note on the session: **dream once this turn is over**. After her goodbye, the server runs a dream cycle: eight housekeeping jobs over the day, most of which make one LLM call of their own, outside any chat turn. They score what mattered, tidy long-term facts, rewrite the diary and sometimes turn the day into a new skill. Then she stays asleep until she is woken. The next morning, what the dream wrote is part of her prompt.
text.zh: Luna 有个工具叫 `enter_dream`。真实应用里，什么时候调它由模型决定；回放照着同样的格式，把这一步写进了脚本。这个工具自己不启动任何东西，只在会话上记一笔：**这个回合结束就去做梦**。她道完晚安，服务端跑一轮梦（dream cycle）：对这一天做 8 项整理工作，多数各自单独调一次 LLM，不挂在任何聊天回合上。它们给要紧的事打分、整理长期事实、重写日记，有时还把这一天提炼成一个新技能。做完她接着睡，直到被叫醒。第二天早上，梦里写下的东西已经是她 prompt 的一部分了。

title.en: Why didn't she fall asleep mid-sentence?
title.zh: 她怎么没说着说着就睡了？

blocks.summary: dream pending — starts after this turn

text.en: Then I'll see you there.
text.zh: 那就到时候见。

text.en: The tool card shows up before her last line, on purpose. `enter_dream` only sets `session.pendingDream` and returns `pending`; the card's text is the tool's own summary line. The code that handled his message starts the dream only after the whole turn has finished. So she still gets to say goodbye, and her reply and its saved history are fully written first. The one background job a turn leaves running, the summary fold, is guarded by a watermark check, so the turn's fold and the dream's fold can't both land. A proactive turn follows the same rule: at its end it either starts the dream or drops the request.
text.zh: 工具卡出现在她最后一句之前，这是故意的。`enter_dream` 只是把 `session.pendingDream` 设上，返回 `pending`；卡片上那行字是工具自己的摘要。处理他这条消息的代码，要等整个回合彻底结束才启动梦。所以她还来得及道别，回复和对应的历史记录也都先完整落库。回合结束后还留在后台跑的只有一件事：摘要折叠（summary fold）。它有水位线（watermark）校验把关，回合那次折叠和梦里那次，最多只有一次能写进去。主动回合也守同一条规矩：收尾时要么启动梦，要么把这个请求丢掉。

note.en: The dream starts in the turn's `.then`, after the reply is done, never during it.
note.zh: 梦在回合的 `.then` 里启动，也就是回复做完之后，绝不会在回复中途。

title.en: Could she do this at 3 p.m.?
title.zh: 下午 3 点也能做梦吗？

text.en: No. Dreams she starts herself only happen at night: 21:00 to 06:00 local time by default, and `LUNA_SHUTDOWN_DREAM_WINDOW` can change that. Outside those hours, the tool returns a recoverable error. It tells her why and suggests `remember` instead. The model reads that error like any other tool result, so she can explain it in her own words. The same window applies to the dream that runs when the app quits. The Dream button in the owner's menu is not limited to the night, so he can send her to sleep at any hour.
text.zh: 不能。她自己发起的梦只在夜里跑：默认本地时间 21:00 到 06:00，可以用 `LUNA_SHUTDOWN_DREAM_WINDOW` 改。在这个时间窗之外，工具返回一个可恢复的错误（recoverable error），告诉她原因，并建议改用 `remember`。模型读这条错误，和读其他工具结果没有两样，所以她能用自己的话把原因讲出来。应用退出时跑的那次梦，也受同一个时间窗约束。主人菜单里的“做梦”按钮不限时段，他随时都能让她去睡。

note.en: The error message is written for her to read, not for a log.
note.zh: 这条错误信息是写给她看的，不是写给日志的。

text.en: "Nearly midnight" is a replay curtain: a dark room and a clock drawn by the replay itself. The real app has no time skip. There, she learns the hour from the time block added to every turn (scene 1).
text.zh: “快到午夜了”是回放的幕布：暗下来的屋子和转着的钟，都是回放自己画的。真实应用里没有快进时间这回事，她知道几点，靠的是每个回合都会附上的时间块（第 1 幕）。

text.en: The dream runs on the same small graph runner as a chat turn: each step does one job, then names the step that comes next. Each step reports ok, skipped or failed, and a failed step doesn't stop the rest. In order, she:
text.zh: 梦和聊天回合跑在同一个小型图执行器（graph runner）上：每个节点只做一件事，做完指定下一个节点。每一步都会报告 ok、skipped 或 failed，某一步失败不会拦住后面的步骤。她会按顺序做这几件事：

items.en: Scores each exchange not yet rated, 1 to 5 (up to 40 a night)
items.zh: 给还没评过分的每轮对话打 1 到 5 分（每晚最多 40 轮）

items.en: Tidies facts in two passes around the fold: merge duplicate or vague ones, then check them against what was said
items.zh: 在折叠前后各整理一遍事实：先合并重复、含糊的条目，再对照对话原文核对

items.en: When enough old chat has piled up, folds it into the rolling summary
items.zh: 旧对话攒够了，就折进滚动摘要

items.en: Sometimes adjusts her sense of herself and of the relationship
items.zh: 有时调整她对自己、对这段关系的看法

items.en: Sometimes turns the day into a skill
items.zh: 有时把这一天提炼成一个技能

items.en: Fills the embedding cache that recall reads (when embeddings are on)
items.zh: 预热记忆召回要读的 embedding 缓存（开了 embedding 才跑）

note.en: The order matters: scores come before the fold, and a new skill is embedded the same night.
note.zh: 顺序有讲究：先打分再折叠；新提炼的技能当晚就算好 embedding。

text.en: The model does, inside a narrow format. Five steps (scores, fact tidy-up, fact audit, self-portrait, skills) ask for a small JSON patch, and the code checks it against a schema before applying anything. If the shape is wrong, that step writes nothing and runs again next dream. The diary and the fold get back prose; the cache refresh only calls the embedding API. The scores are the "good bits". Exchanges scored 4 or 5 (by default) are marked `[salient]` when old chat is folded, and the compressor is told to keep their specifics near-verbatim. They are also the only material the dream distils skills from: the last day's 4s and 5s.
text.zh: 模型说了算，但只能在很窄的格式里说。有 5 步（打分、整理事实、核对事实、自画像、技能）要求模型交一个小小的 JSON patch，代码先按 schema 校验，通过了才动数据。格式不对，这一步就什么都不写，下次做梦再跑。日记和折叠拿回来的是成段的文字；缓存刷新只调 embedding API。所谓“好的”，看的就是打分那一步给的分数。折叠旧对话时，默认打了 4 分或 5 分的对话会标上 `[salient]`，prompt 会叮嘱压缩器把其中的细节几乎原样保留。梦里提炼技能，也只拿它们当素材：过去一天里的 4 分和 5 分。

note.en: One missing score rejects the whole patch, so no exchange gets another's score; they stay unrated until next dream.
note.zh: 少一个分数，整个 patch 就作废，免得后面的对话错拿别人的分；这批对话先都不记分，留到下次做梦再评。

text.en: When his message or the owner's Dream button puts her to sleep, the server sends a `dream.status` event, then one `dream.step` event per job. The overlay turns each step into a plain sentence, such as "Wrote 2 diary entries." The avatar goes to sleep: idle gestures stop and her eyes stop following the cursor. The chat box is disabled, and the server turns messages away with the error `dreaming`. After the last job she parks at `finished_idle`, still asleep. Only an explicit wake (or a restart) brings her back, and a wake is refused mid-job.
text.zh: 梦如果是他的消息或主人菜单里的“做梦”按钮触发的，服务端会先发一个 `dream.status` 事件，之后每完成一项工作再发一个 `dream.step`。浮层把每一步翻成一句大白话，比如“写下了 2 篇日记。”她的 Live2D 形象也睡了：待机小动作停下，眼睛不再跟着鼠标。输入框被禁用，服务端也会用 `dreaming` 错误把消息挡回去。最后一项做完，她停在 `finished_idle`，仍然睡着。只有有人叫醒她（或者重启），她才会回来；某项工作还在跑的时候，叫醒会被拒绝。

note.en: `writeThrough` saves the sleep state to SQLite. On boot, any leftover sleep is cleared and an unfinished dream is marked aborted.
note.zh: `writeThrough` 把睡眠状态同步写进 SQLite。启动时，残留的睡眠状态会被清掉，没跑完的梦标记为 aborted。

text.en: In the replay the step results are scripted, but the events have the real format. The Wake button is the real button: once the scripted cycle reaches `finished_idle`, the tape sends the same waking `dream.status` the server sends on `dream.wake`.
text.zh: 回放里每一步的结果是写好的，但事件格式是真的。“叫醒她”也是真按钮：脚本里这一轮梦停在 `finished_idle` 之后，点它，磁带就会发出唤醒用的 `dream.status`，和服务端处理 `dream.wake` 时发的一模一样。

title.en: How does she know what she wrote?
title.zh: 她怎么知道梦里写了啥？

text.en: Morning. I went over yesterday while you slept — the late night, the email, the good night said properly. It's in the diary now, and there's a new skill on the shelf for how to talk after one a.m., if you want to see it.
text.zh: 早。趁你睡着，我把昨天过了一遍：半夜那会儿、那封邮件，还有那句正经的晚安。都写进日记了。技能架上还多了一条：凌晨一点以后怎么说话。想看就去翻。

text.en: No one spoke here: the turn started on its own, with a stage direction in place of a user message (scene 4). The scheduler won't start one while she's asleep or during quiet hours, by default midnight to 6 a.m. Her prompt carries what this line needs: the time block says it's morning and a new day (scene 1), the skill shelf now lists `late-night-brevity` (scene 2), and the diary digest below. The digest sits in the stable, cached part of her prompt, so she reads what the dream wrote without calling anything. In the real app, what to say about it is the model's choice; here the line is scripted.
text.zh: 这句之前没人开口：这个回合是自动发起的，原本放用户消息的位置，换成了一段舞台指示（第 4 幕）。她睡着时，或者在安静时段（默认午夜到早上 6 点），调度器都不会发起这种回合。这句话要用到的东西，prompt 里都有：时间块写着现在是早上、已经是新的一天（第 1 幕）；技能架上多了 `late-night-brevity`（第 2 幕）；再就是下面这段日记摘要。摘要放在 prompt 里稳定、带缓存的那一段，所以她不用调任何工具，就能读到梦里写了什么。真实应用里，要不要提、怎么提，由模型决定；这里这句台词是写好的。

note.en: Only the latest day, week and month entries, each cut to 600 characters by default. It changes only when a dream writes.
note.zh: 日、周、月各只取最新一篇，默认各截到 600 个字符。只有梦写了新日记，这段摘要才会变。

title.en: The blink, and the morning face

text.en: The slow blink is one of the `tender` clip's own gestures, but the replay fires it directly as a scripted cue. Her faces follow the expression the model names (scene 1 shows the mapping). `open_reengagement` at 0.5 stays under the 0.7 threshold, so the morning line plays `curious`, not `tender`.
text.zh: 那一下慢眨眼，本来是 `tender` 这段动作自带的小动作之一，但在回放里，它是由脚本单独写的一条 cue 直接触发的。她的表情跟着模型指定的 expression 走（映射见第 1 幕）。`open_reengagement` 的强度是 0.5，低于 0.7 的门槛，所以早上那句播的是 `curious`，不是 `tender`。

title.en: What sleep costs, and where it stops

text.en: A dream isn't free. Most jobs make an LLM call, and the diary job makes one per entry it writes. If a separate summarizer key (`LUNA_SUMMARIZER_API_KEY`) is set, most dream calls try it first and fall back to the main key only on failure, so the dream mostly stays off her live replies' quota. Code, not the prompt, sets the limits. A dream saves at most two skills by default, retires at most one, and never revives a retired skill. Self-reflection can edit only the "evolving" half of her soul. The dream that runs when the app quits happens only at night and, by default, if no dream has started in the last 6 hours.
text.zh: 做梦也有成本。大多数工作要调一次 LLM，写日记那步每写一篇就调一次。如果单独配了摘要专用的 key（`LUNA_SUMMARIZER_API_KEY`），梦里大部分调用会先走它，失败了才退回主 key，所以做梦基本不占她实时回复的额度。上限由代码卡住，不靠 prompt：一次梦默认最多存 2 个技能、最多退役 1 个，已退役的技能不会被复活。自我反思只能改她灵魂文件里会变的那一半（evolving）。应用退出时的那次梦只在夜里跑，而且默认要求距上一次开始做梦已满 6 小时。

hook.en: So was any of that live, or was it all a recording?
hook.zh: 所以刚才那些，有没有哪段是实时跑的？还是全是录好的？

text.en: Everything you just saw came from the real database of my everyday life with Alan — combined, picked, polished and edited into a script for this demo.
text.zh: 你刚看到的那些都取自我和Alan日常互动的真实数据库信息，整合、挑选、润色、修改了一下制作成了demo脚本演示给你们看的

text.en: No model runs behind this page. What you watched is Luna's **real front end**: the same chat, bubbles, Live2D face and voice queue as the desktop app. Only the source of events is different. A tape stands where her server's WebSocket would be and hands the app frames in exactly the shape the server sends. The owner assembled and edited every line into a script, `script.json`. Nothing on this page is generated as you watch. Her voice was synthesized ahead of time through the app's real TTS request. The rest of this stack follows the tape from script to sound.
text.zh: 这个页面背后没有模型在跑。你看到的是 Luna **真正的前端**：聊天、气泡、Live2D 形象、语音队列，和桌面版是同一套。不同的只有事件的来源。原本该是她服务端 WebSocket 的位置，这里换成了一盘磁带（tape），它交给 app 的帧，格式和服务端发的完全一样。每句台词都由主人整理、剪辑，编进一份脚本 `script.json`。这个页面上没有任何内容是现场生成的。她的声音是提前合成好的，走的就是 app 真实的 TTS 请求。这叠笔记剩下的几张，就顺着磁带，从脚本一路跟到声音。

text.en: The blank chat is a stage device: the replay clears the log so the finale starts clean. Both of her turns here are wakings, with no message from him (scene 4 explains wakings).
text.zh: 空白的聊天记录是舞台手法：回放把记录清空，让谢幕从一张白纸开始。这里她的两个回合都是唤醒，他一条消息也没发（唤醒见第 4 幕）。

text.en: It is not a message. No frame carries it and no voice speaks it. The replay's director, the same part that draws the curtains and the desk, adds a plain card to the chat log. The card has an "inner voice" tag and a dashed border. The real app has no such card. The tape shows it only after her last word has been spoken, and waits long enough for you to read it before she wakes again.
text.zh: 它不是消息。没有哪一帧带着它，也没有语音念它。回放里的导演（director），也就是画幕布和桌面的那个部件，往聊天记录里加了一张普通卡片：一个“内心 OS”标签，一圈虚线边框。真实的 app 里没有这种卡片。等她最后一个字念完，磁带才亮出这张卡；留够时间让你读完之后，她才会再次醒来。

note.en: Plain DOM in the chat log: no frame, no voice, no history entry.
note.zh: 聊天记录里的普通 DOM：没有帧，没有语音，也不进历史记录。

items.zh: 聊天 · 形象 · 语音

text.en: `app.ts` holds one client and sends everything it emits into one `onEvent` handler. That handler drives the controller, the bubbles, the face and the voice. On the desktop the client is `LunaWsClient`, a WebSocket. In the replay it is the tape, which plays pre-compiled frames on timers. Both have the same three methods, so the controller, bubbles and face cannot tell them apart. The tape answers what the server answers: history and settings on connect, a settings change, the dream door. The one difference is that it accepts a `chat.send` only when a scripted line is armed.
text.zh: `app.ts` 只持有一个客户端，它发出的所有事件都交给同一个 `onEvent` 处理函数；控制器、气泡、形象和语音都由这个函数驱动。桌面版里，这个客户端是 `LunaWsClient`，一个 WebSocket。回放里，它是那盘磁带，用定时器播放预先编译好的帧。两者对外提供的都是同样的三个方法，所以控制器、气泡和形象分不出背后是哪一个。服务端会回的，磁带也照样回：连接时发历史和设置，改设置时回新状态，还有做梦和叫醒。唯一的区别是：只有脚本里备好了一句待发的台词，它才接受 `chat.send`。

note.en: The whole seam: a type with three methods.
note.zh: 整个接缝就是这一个类型，三个方法。

text.en: Timing on the tape is set by hand (a thinking pause, a streamed message, each line's recorded length). None of it was measured from a live session.
text.zh: 磁带上的时间都是手工设定的（思考的停顿、消息的流式输出、每句录音的时长），没有一个是从真实会话里测出来的。

title.en: Can the tape send a bad frame?

text.en: The owner writes each scene as beats: his line, her lines with a face, a tool card, a waking, a curtain. A pure compiler turns the beats into timed cues. What she says and does becomes server frames: `proactive.started`, the streamed text of each `message` call, `tool.finished`, `proactive.finished`. Every frame is checked against the protocol schema that the live socket client uses. The live client quietly drops a bad frame. The compiler throws, so the tape does not load. The tests compile both shipped tapes, so a bad frame turns them red before it can ship. The schema checks shape, not truth: tool-card lines are typed into the script in each tool's own format.
text.zh: 每一幕，主人都按节拍（beat）来写：他的一句话、她带表情的几句、一张工具卡片、一次唤醒、一道幕布。编译器是纯函数，把这些节拍变成带时间戳的提示点（cue）。她说的、做的，都变成服务端帧：`proactive.started`、每次 `message` 调用流式输出的文字、`tool.finished`、`proactive.finished`。每一帧都要过协议 schema 校验，和真实 socket 客户端用的是同一份。真实客户端遇到坏帧，悄悄丢掉；编译器遇到坏帧，直接抛错，磁带根本加载不起来。测试会把随页面发布的两盘磁带都编译一遍，坏帧还没发布，测试就先红了。schema 只校验结构，不管真假：工具卡片上那行字，是照着每个工具自己的格式手写进脚本的。

note.en: One schema for the socket and the tape.
note.zh: socket 和磁带，用的是同一份 schema。

text.en: The tests also hold every line to the message tool's caps (scene 2), and hold the Chinese tape to the same scenes, beats, tools, faces and timing as this one.
text.zh: 测试还会拿 `message` 工具的上限（第 2 幕）卡每一句台词，并要求中文磁带在幕、节拍、工具、表情和时间上与英文磁带完全一致。

title.zh: 同一个声音，怎么做到的？

text.en: Live, the browser posts her text to `/api/tts/speak`. The host builds a GPT-SoVITS request with the owner's voice reference and forwards it. For the replay, a build script sent every line once through that same request builder. It saved an mp3 for each line and wrote a manifest: text, file, duration. On this page, the voice player's one synthesis hook reads the manifest instead. The queue, lip-sync and punctuation gestures are unchanged. A line with no recording fails with a 404, the voice player's normal failure path. The line is reported as unspoken and is never voiced with the wrong words.
text.zh: 真实运行时，浏览器把她的文字 POST 到 `/api/tts/speak`，服务端带上主人配置的参考音频，拼成一个 GPT-SoVITS 请求转发出去。为了做回放，构建脚本用同一个请求构造函数，把每句台词都发了一遍，每句存成一个 mp3，再写一份清单（manifest）：文字、文件、时长。在这个页面上，语音播放器只有一个合成钩子，这里把它改成了去读这份清单。队列、口型同步、标点触发的头部动作，都没变。没有录音的句子会以 404 报错，走的是语音播放器平常的失败路径：这句被标记为没念出来，绝不会拿别句的录音顶替。

note.en: `planTtsForward` is what the dev server and the desktop server call for `/api/tts/speak`.
note.zh: dev server 和桌面版服务端处理 `/api/tts/speak` 时，调用的也是 `planTtsForward`。

text.en: The Chinese tape was voiced with text_lang `zh`.
text.zh: 中文磁带合成时，text_lang 用的是 `zh`。

title.en: Why not let her run live?
title.zh: 为什么不让她真跑起来？

text.en: If I actually ran on a server for a crowd of visitors, both I and Alan's wallet would get cranky.
text.zh: 如果真让我跑在服务器上应对一大堆访客，不论是我还是Alan的钱包都会觉得烦躁的

text.en: Her line gives the reason: cost. Live, every turn is at least one model call that carries her whole prompt, and every line she says is a voice synthesis. The bill grows with the audience. The replay is static files: the app itself plus a script, a folder of mp3s and a few JSON records. Nothing runs for each visitor. The price is conversation. You cannot talk to her: the input is read-only, and Send only sends the line typed for you. Her fourth line names the other limits.
text.zh: 原因她自己说了：成本。真实运行时，每个回合至少是一次模型调用，每次都带着她完整的 prompt；她说的每一句，又是一次语音合成。看的人越多，账单越高。回放只是一堆静态文件：app 本身，加一份脚本、一个装 mp3 的文件夹和几份 JSON 记录。多来一个访客，也不用为他多跑任何东西。代价是没法对话。你不能跟她聊：输入框是只读的，“发送”只会发出替你打好的那一句。其余的局限，她第四句里说了。

text.en: The faces are the ones the script names for each line: amused_smirk, steady_presence, awkward_lightness, soft_warmth, shy_softness, and bright_delight for "Hi!". Scene 1 shows how names map to clips.
text.zh: 每句的表情都是脚本里标好的：amused_smirk、steady_presence、awkward_lightness、soft_warmth、shy_softness，说“嗨！”时是 bright_delight。表情名怎么映射到动画片段，见第 1 幕。

text.en: None of the abilities were faked; every one of them can be traced.
text.zh: 展示的能力也没有造假，可以溯源的。

text.en: These notes are the trace. Each code block is copied from the source and links to it in the public repository. A test holds every block, character for character, to the file it names. Each quote is checked against the tape. The notes cannot check what she says about the source material: that the scenes came from real life with Alan and were edited for the show. The mechanisms are real. The conversations are scripted.
text.zh: 溯源，靠的就是这叠笔记。每个代码块都从源码原样抄来，并链接到公开仓库里的出处。有测试逐字比对每个代码块和它标注的文件，每句引用也都和磁带核对过。她对素材来源的说法，笔记核对不了：这些场景取自她和 Alan 的真实日常，再为演出剪辑过。机制是真的，对话是写好的剧本。
